body:
We need to build trust and power within our communities year-round, making sure that our friends and neighbors know the stakes in 2024, and that they’re ready to vote accordingly. | | |
---

Something big is going on, and we need your help to tackle it. There’s this far right group called Moms for Liberty. They call themselves “joyful warriors,” but not everyone sees it that way. They are an extremist group that’s pushing against inclusive education.
What’s worse is they’re attracting some heavy-hitters in GOP politics . This week they’re having a big conference, and guess who’s speaking? Trump and DeSantis.
But here’s the good news - we’re not alone in this fight. There are many grassroots organizations like us that believe in Democracy and inclusive education. We’re all speaking out against extremism, and some are even asking Marriott to cancel the conference. [https://www.nytimes.com/2023/06/28/arts/design/moms-liberty-museum-american-revolution.html]
Still, Moms for Liberty isn’t backing down. They’re fundraising aggressively, even managing to quickly raise $45,000 after the Southern Poverty Law Center called them out. And some big dark money GOP donor is matching it!
So, this is where you come in. We need your support to stand up against this challenge. Your donation [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/momsagainstdesantis] can help us keep fighting for inclusive education by electing Democratic women up and down the ballot. I just got out of a meeting.
Hi All -
I just got out of a meeting with my campaign team and I want to share a few takeaways with you. As you read, I hope you’ll consider donating with this **[link](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/65583179/413924986/658996770?&refcode=E3184-20230628-EOQ3-SL-DeadlineEOQ&amount=25&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMjQvMS8xMDMxMTgiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiZjFjYjZlMDktMTIxNi1lZTExLWE5YmItMDAyMjQ4MzJlYjczIiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=jdrN4ZJn9ucd_B3N2X5tSHUAMWW6CEVOFjuLtnqqNYQ=)**.
**Here’s where we stand:** As of today, we are only 3 days away from our second end-of-quarter deadline when we have to submit our fundraising numbers to the FEC. Based on what has come in through ActBlue, we are still over $18,000 away from our goal.
**Why this matters:** Republicans have not been shy about the fact that they want to flip my seat. That’s why I was listed at the top of Kevin McCarthy’s target list and the NRCC has already spent five figures on attack ads against me. They’ve even called me “California’s most vulnerable Democrat.” If we lose this seat, we lose the House again. It’s that simple.
**What decisions we need to make:** After this deadline, we will have to make some major decisions about how many staff we can add to our team (including hiring a new Field Director) and how much we can put behind our digital ads to fight back against the GOP’s attacks. It all is going to depend on how much we can raise before the deadline on Friday.
**Other considerations:** Dark money is always a huge threat in this toss-up seat. I’m one of the few members of Congress who doesn’t take a dime of corporate PAC money (and actually sticks to it!) but I need your help to match the Republicans dollar for dollar to combat their onslaught of ads. If they spend $500,000 against us, we have to spend $500,000 back.
**What I need from you:** Well, I need your help to get us closer to our end-of-quarter goal before the end of the day. We’re still over $18,000 behind and if we fall short, the Republicans are going to double down on their attacks against me. And we won’t be able to get our field organizing started or have enough resources to fight back against these negative ads.
That’s why I’m asking you to please rush in the biggest donation you possibly can today. Without your support, there’s no way we’re going to be able to reach this goal.
Here is a link: **[https://secure.actblue.com/donate/JHCA-09-Email-June2023-FR-EOQ](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/65583180/413924987/658996770?&refcode=E3184-20230628-EOQ3-SL-DeadlineEOQ&amount=25&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMjQvMS8xMDMxMTgiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiZjFjYjZlMDktMTIxNi1lZTExLWE5YmItMDAyMjQ4MzJlYjczIiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=jdrN4ZJn9ucd_B3N2X5tSHUAMWW6CEVOFjuLtnqqNYQ=)**
I know we can do this!
\- Josh

Stockton, CA 95202

body:
| Hi there —

In just a moment, [I’m going to ask you to split a donation between my campaign and the Voter Protection Project before our end-of-quarter deadline on Friday.](https://act.protectvoting.org/go/48572?t=6&akid=8800%2E878179%2EPjXKAQ) But first, I hope you’ll give me the chance to explain why this deadline is so important.

In just a few days, our team will close the books on this quarter’s fundraising and start filing a report on our campaign finances for the Federal Election Commission. Shortly after that, those numbers will be made public for everyone to see.

With a recent poll showing this race statistically tied, there’s no doubt that Mitch McConnell, potential Republican opponents, and their wealthy allies will be watching our numbers closely. If Republicans think we look weak, you can bet they will throw the kitchen sink at us to flip this toss-up seat — and the Senate — red.

Unfortunately, our fundraising has slowed down quite a bit over the last few weeks and as of right now, we’re not on track to hit our target before the deadline. We can’t afford to fall short and send a weak fundraising report to the FEC, folks, so I’m counting on this team to help us get back on track.

[Can I count on you to split a donation between the Voter Protection Project and my campaign $10 to help us defend this battleground seat and our Senate majority? # **
The Fed's Digital Dollar Is Here!**
**It is official.** The digital dollar, once talked about, is here. Reuters reported that on Tuesday November 15th, 2022, a statement from the Fed's of New York, announcing that Global Banking Giants and the New York Fed are testing the digital dollar in a 12-week pilots.
Citigroup, HSBC, Mastercard, and Wells Fargo are among the financial companies participating in the experiment. According to New York Fed, the project, which is called the regulated liability network, will use simulated data.

Dear
Friend,

I hear
from people all the time that Thomas Sowell is one of their
heroes. For those people-and you may be among them-I'm thrilled
to share a digital copy of one of his commentaries with you,
absolutely free: "Trickle Down" Theory and "Tax Cuts for the
Rich."

"Tax cuts
for the rich" is a favorite argument of those who oppose lower
tax rates. But does imposing higher tax rates on wealthy
Americans actually increase the amount of revenue coming into the
federal government?

Hoover
Institution Senior Fellow Thomas Sowell takes an empirical
approach in his commentary, "Trickle Down" Theory and "Tax Cuts
for the Rich."

Sowell
separates fact from fiction when it comes to tax rates and uses
real life data and examples to prove that lower tax rates for all
actually lead to greater revenue for the government.

| | | Dear Fellow American,Hillsdale College has selected you to participate in its [**National Referendum on the Administrative State**](http://trk.secureandprosper._rtWgENo1KchajVxQ).

Responding will only take a few minutes. Your input as an informed patriot is needed right away...because **our country is facing a constitutional crisis**.

It’s a crisis that involves a fundamental political question: **who rules whom?**

The Constitution established a limited government in which the **people** ruled through their elected officials. Under this form of government, America became the freest and most prosperous nation in history.

Today, however, our constitutional system is one that increasingly exists in name only.**The Constitution of “We the People” is being replaced by an elite, out-of-touch, and unaccountable administrative state that rules without the consent of American citizens.** This means we live in an era of growing bureaucratic despotism, manifested in an administrative state that bypasses the Constitution, rejects the separation of powers, and replaces the rule of law with regulations.

**But we can’t just TALK about the problem. We also have to TAKE ACTION—to DO SOMETHING about it, while there’s still time to save our country.**

That is why I’m writing to you today.

Hillsdale College is committed to returning to the Constitution of “We the People”—before it’s too late.

To do that, I need your input. What are your opinions on this topic—knowing that we can propose SOLUTIONS that will restore liberty?

**Please let me know your thoughts today by answering the National Referendum on the Administrative State using this secure link:**

**[https://lp.hillsdale.edu/administrative-state-survey/](http://trk.secureandprosper._z66C6QNbGA)**

Thank you for being on the side of the Constitution and liberty!

Warm regards,

Larry P. Arnn

subject: I had to reach personally, friend
body:
| | | | | [](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/e_s17_main_cobrandedemail_c3)

---
Dear friend, one of the biggest moments of our year is coming up fast, and I knew I had to reach out to you early with a crucial update. Our planet is at a critical tipping point. This means our fight to protect vital ecosystems and the creatures that depend on them is more urgent than ever.
Friends of the Earth won’t take excuses from bad actors and the mega-polluting industries pushing our planet to the brink. We see clearly that **corporate pollution is a choice.** **Together, we WILL hold companies accountable for that choice. **
**Right now, innocent animals are facing extreme risk of extinction from human-driven habitat loss and the worsening climate crisis. Mega-manufacturing plants are covering our planet in single-use plastics just to rack up more profits. The amount of their plastics in our oceans could exceed the number of fish by 2050 unless we act. Meanwhile, mining, logging and drilling companies are aggressively attacking the Endangered Species Act – our strongest protection for vulnerable creatures and the vital habitats they call home. **
We know the consequences of their rampant greed will be devastating pollution and the destruction of lands and waterways essential to wildlife survival and to human health. **But it doesn’t have to be this way, and we don’t have to stand aside while our only Earth collapses under this terrible burden. **
**That’s why this opportunity is so important: A generous group of donors is matching every gift we receive up to our $150,000 End of Fiscal Year goal, but only until midnight FRIDAY. Because you've been such a committed supporter, we created a custom match link you can use to be the first to DOUBLE your impact at this crucial moment in our fight for the planet and its inhabitants. So please hurry and make your gift for our planet now! Here’s your personal link:**
| | [[EARLY MATCH ACCESS FOR dpwillis67@gmail.com]](https://us.engagingnetworks.app/page/email/click/10012/1850163?email=RepJ2ZGQKX6xm5Aey7FwClESkN1MQhKC&campid=UI6tX83ZqbKZkArzVWMSmA==)
---
This goal means so much to our organization and the planet. We chose you to be part of this select group for early match access because we know you understand how high the stakes are for our Earth and everything that lives on it. **When you make your early-bird membership donation now, you'll be ensuring that Friends of the Earth can continue to mobilize activists on the ground, keep pressure on our lawmakers to do the right thing and stop the corporation-driven pollution crisis from putting the future of our planet at risk. **
The situation is dire, but getting complacent or giving in to despair is simply not an option. That’s why we must seize this opportunity for our planet right now, friend. **Matches like this don’t come often, and the stakes for our only Earth have never been higher. **So we’re counting on committed environmentalists like you to set the pace for the rest of our community.
**We've got to make this goal really count. So please, your personalized match access link is right here – donate now to have every dollar doubled toward our crucial End of Fiscal Year goal:**
| | [[EARLY MATCH ACCESS FOR dpwillis67@gmail.com]](https://us.engagingnetworks.app/page/email/click/10012/1850163?email=RepJ2ZGQKX6xm5Aey7FwClESkN1MQhKC&campid=UI6tX83ZqbKZkArzVWMSmA==)

Thank you,

Erich Pica

| | | | | It’s Cliff, here. I wanted to make sure you heard that pro-choice champion, Kirsten Gillibrand, is running for reelection. Her message is below: Peter, it’s been a year since the conservative majority on the Supreme Court ruled to officially overturn Roe v. Wade. In the year since then, we’ve watched state after state pass increasingly extreme abortion bans. Now, the future of our reproductive rights will be on the ballot again in 2024 – and the odds are stacked against us. Democrats are defending 23 Senate seats. Republicans only have to defend 10. name: Heidi Ganahl
subject: Corruption in Pueblo, Fighting the Woke Agenda + Bonus Episode With RFK Jr.
body:
Episode #13 of Unleashed with Heidi Ganahl is LIVE!
[](https://heidi4gov.cmail20.com/t/i-l-aphlld-tkwdjuidt-r/) Hi Peter, This week's episode of Unleashed is all about one of my favorite stops on the campaign trail, and a place I spent many summer weekends as a kid fishing with my dad on Pueblo Reservoir... the "Home of the Heroes" Pueblo, CO!Can Pueblo survive the corruption, crime, and chaos taking over the city? And who has the courage to stand up against it? I bring on Pueblo mayoral candidate Randy Thurston and 2022 Pueblo County Clerk candidate Nathan Baxter to talk all about the corruption, back-door dealings, old-school politicians, and union leaders that run everything - into the ground.
### **Episode #13 - CAN PUEBLO SURVIVE CORRUPTION, CRIME, AND CHAOS?**
[](https://heidi4gov.cmail20.com/t/i-l-aphlld-tkwdjuidt-y/) [WATCH ON YOUTUBE](https://heidi4gov.cmail20.com/t/i-l-aphlld-tkwdjuidt-j/) [WATCH ON RUMBLE](https://heidi4gov.cmail20.com/t/i-l-aphlld-tkwdjuidt-t/) [LISTEN HERE](https://heidi4gov.cmail20.com/t/i-l-aphlld-tkwdjuidt-i/) _Not into podcasts? I post transcripts of my monologues and full episode breakdowns every week on my Substack.[You can subscribe here!](https://heidi4gov.cmail20.com/t/i-l-aphlld-tkwdjuidt-d/)_
## **HOW I'M FIGHTING THE WOKE AGENDA:**
Something the Ganahl household has done to fight the woke agenda is switching our everyday products from woke corporations (no more Target and we are sticking strong to that) to **ALL American-made manufacturing**. Let me introduce you to the America-first parallel economy!

We are shifting our spending on regular everyday items from cheap CCP manufacturers to clean, American-made, American-worker manufacturing. So far, we've loved all the products and nothing feels better than knowing that our money is being well spent in alignment with our values. **Want to learn more? Head to[ patriotswitch.com/heidi](https://heidi4gov.cmail20.com/t/i-l-aphlld-tkwdjuidt-h/)**. [](https://heidi4gov.cmail20.com/t/i-l-aphlld-tkwdjuidt-k/)
## **WATCH THIS VIRAL RFK JR. VIDEO FROM A CU BOULDER DEBATE I HOSTED IN 2019 (REMOVED BY YOUTUBE):**
When I was a Regent at the University of Colorado, one of the problems I was most concerned about was the attack on free speech. I founded the Free to Be Coalition with some peers of mine as an effort to promote healthy, respectful debate on University campuses -- a project I'm extremely proud of, hosting big names on both sides of the aisle to demonstrate debate to students across the country.One of those big names was **Robert F. Kennedy, Jr.** -- one of the ONLY liberals who would come to our debate at CU Boulder. He was kind, intelligent, and such a great example of how to debate productively. Too bad Hotez won't debate him on his vaccine stance... The entire 2.5-hour debate is on my podcast as a [BONUS EPISODE](https://heidi4gov.cmail20.com/t/i-l-aphlld-tkwdjuidt-b/), as well as on [Rumble](https://heidi4gov.cmail20.com/t/i-l-aphlld-tkwdjuidt-n/). However, **the video was[REMOVED by YouTube](https://heidi4gov.cmail20.com/t/i-l-aphlld-tkwdjuidt-p/) for spreading "medical misinformation." **Ironic due to the fact that my post was about promoting free speech and productive debate in the first place. ALSO ironic because he calls himself "pro-vaccine" in the clip. [Here's the clip](https://heidi4gov.cmail20.com/t/i-l-aphlld-tkwdjuidt-x/) if you're interested in seeing what all the fuss is about. [](https://heidi4gov.cmail20.com/t/i-l-aphlld-tkwdjuidt-m/) I've got a spicy podcast coming your way this week, stay tuned...Heidi [](https://heidi4gov.cmail20.com/t/i-l-aphlld-tkwdjuidt-c/)[](https://heidi4gov.cmail20.com/t/i-l-aphlld-tkwdjuidt-q/)[](https://heidi4gov.cmail20.com/t/i-l-aphlld-tkwdjuidt-a/)[](https://heidi4gov.cmail20.com/t/i-l-aphlld-tkwdjuidt-f/)[](https://heidi4gov.cmail20.com/t/i-l-aphlld-tkwdjuidt-z/)[](https://heidi4gov.cmail20.com/t/i-l-aphlld-tkwdjuidt-v/) | Heidi GanahlLone Tree, CO [Preferences](https://heidi4gov.updatemyprofile.com/i-aphlld-66AAC70D-tkwdjuidt-e) | [Unsubscribe](https://heidi4gov.cmail20.com/t/i-u-aphlld-tkwdjuidt-s/)

_**[This might just be the single most important email I've ever sent. Republicans by _$12,000,000+_ since we took back the House in January

Democrats control the Senate and the presidency, so House Republicans have the most important job in DC.

They are the ONLY firewall we have to stop Joe Biden and Chuck Schumer's radical agenda. And even then, our Majority in the House comes down to just a few seats. **That 's why this email is especially important.**

**_[Here's my plan: I set a goal to get every Conservative I can reach with this email to pitch in JUST five or ten dollars.](https://e.conservativefwd.com/rd/9z2z5s8jqpi2qigh1m0q319retbnfh1deamio0bs2eg_rp22sh2s8i66o70s1gmcor1chh2bs "Here’s my plan: I set a goal to get every Conservative I can reach with this email to pitch in JUST five or ten dollars.")_ **

If everyone reading this gives that much, we'll catch up just in time before our June deadline.

YOU are key to my goal. We've stood together before, and I know we can win big again! Can I count on you?

**[**YES**](https://e.conservativefwd.com/rd/9z2z3q1b6uoler6mi51ceivl01gccthf7ap98s44cq0_rp22sh2s8i66o70s1gmcor1chh2bs) _[**NO**](https://e.conservativefwd.com/rd/9z2zvnl585sgmotemdmn5klc3nt9gkv1oqa03dpjatg_rp22sh2s8i66o70s1gmcor1chh2bs)**

Thanks for all you do for freedom.

- Kellyanne Conway

## House Targets Biden China Connection
The House Oversight Committee [released text messages](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxskLFytCAURp9GOxy8IEhB8Td2-7cpHYSr3gzCjrCavH1mU6f7Zr7mnPPxmB-OIqXtvzvQ1jXPzle6cOaKgWEgZmiDXREBRYu2V-PIhR700O5WjcF4ZQat5WKC0tz1EvQCXCxD7xfekgUOgisw3AwCoOMjSGdWKdD06LlsJMdANZ_dZ6ZUd1zjd77w7Hw-2mj3Wp-lEf8amBqY7vvu1vyV8C7vv4HpmSNV8qWBaaGAiQVMhIVRunK88MBUWcmJ7a9U8WR-p4QF2fIq71FYQPdWLyzhzQ4sxW3I8MBzw9KeNjxvipGK0o3k2-Eo_nLVvzP9BAAA___x52yB) from 2017 that show Hunter Biden tying his father to his business dealings, despite President Biden's denial this week that he had any involvement. In one message, Hunter tells a Chinese partner that he's sitting with his father and that if a deal wasn't settled immediately, they'd face Hunter's "ability to forever hold a grudge." In another message, Hunter demands $10 million from a Chinese executive, noting, ["Bidens are the best I know](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxs0LFyrCAUgOGnwQ4HDyhaUNzGbm-b0mHhsJ4Mwg6wmn37TFKn_pt_vo_bdrMUKT3-2wNNC3mzrtGJm5g4LBzkBp03ARFQdmiGaZ6F1KMeu92MSjkNcnZO6UkHC9OiUQgNo3VqGIeODAiQYoJFLKME6MUMyi5BSVwGdEIxJdBTy6X_zJTajiG-84mld_nootlbe1Ym_zFYGazXdfUhfyW86k9nsD5zpEauMlj3V2pYuMfDJo-eD-LgbqeEFTkmLI83D1QOfkdnXxX5nTymym1Bfsfa-G5P5C6nhK5RTrUrxj8vipHqpJkSj8NS_N1qfyt9BwAA___qhmrl) at doing exactly what the Chairman wants from this (partnership)."

Hunter Biden pled guilty last week to tax charges in a deal that avoided jail time, but the House is zeroing in on the issue of President Biden's involvement in possible corruption and now possibly a cover-up, as [charged by several whistle-blowers](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxs0LGynCAUgOGn0Q4HDyJSUKSx27QpHZTDejIIDrBL9u0z99a3_pt_vj-P7WEpUHz-thea6tNmj0pv3PjMQDMQG_TOeERA0aMZ52XhQkkl-9M4Je0u5GgR7ajmSS6HH5VanFSznrjuyQAHwWfQXEsBMPAFJqv9JFCPePCpmzg6qikPfxPFeqIPn_TGPBzp6oM5a71LJ351sHawttYGn_5FbOWrd7Be6Mh2sMZPZUeKnvJVGOXC2kmlBtxDapjZESxd7HzFipnt5DCyO6cd2f7KhIXBWCq7bbbPbO-TZbxTrn027m4UApVZdRN_XpbC91f9mel_AAAA__8Jbmw4).
## Airlines Warn of Travel Delays for July 4
The July 4 holiday weekend is shaping up as a major test for airlines, with delays and cancellations already hitting the East Coast -- [nearly 1,000 flights were canceled](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxskLFugzAQQL8GNkfHHQZ78NAlW7p2RFd8DlddIAIrUf6-SueOT295el-X6cJqul4_-Saplm3iuepDJhgcRoc0YZtTEUGhVlI3hAA0-tG3SwoBPAxDwbFgkcjkYSyRuMSIXRe41YSABANGiJ4QTxCw51h6ktjJDH3Tg2St23762XStixR7bQ_ZT_N2ay0ttd6Phj4aPDd45vsqz-Ot3rBXnU0aPC-baeaXqzs_xFwxvS7VZTF-HY51N13lcOMMEnryPlLuQsge6Tt68l0QyTlQu6d8f6qZHsPY9HC9sdpfRv3_ym8AAAD__482YXM) Wednesday and 4,800 were delayed. For travelers, it's [a perfect storm](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxsj7FuhDAQRL_GdKBlbQwULtK4u7QpkTHrYyNjn8CB5O8jUqcbzUjz9D4e08Nx5PR8dxuZEvLkfOGTJtA1jjXKCavFBCIkWZFp9TCA7Lu-q1YzguuwnbXE0PkWZw9e6RDCvPRD6xRWbBBQgsYRxk4iNjCgcmNQksaWPCihgBYueW8-M6eyUog_-aS98XmrollLeR1Cvgm0Au11XY1P6d4E2vtZoAV950Ggnb8OTnQcAq3jvS67OynWV6a74bTQd7OWLVa7WV4Xx8iH7oWC5-Y4_vHK__q_AQAA___eBVnP): a combination of thunderstorms in the East, staffing shortages at airlines and air traffic control towers, and all of it hitting during the busiest travel days of the summer. Experts say that if you need to fly, you should arrive early at the airport, pack your essentials in carry-on luggage, and know your legal rights in case of problems ([Click Here to Review](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxsUL1utDAQfBrTgZY1-Keg-Bp397Up0cYshyNjn7BziLeP7qoUaaaYP43m4zbfKMSQ7v9p56mueSZfw5NnUC3aFuWMzTKtzMiy4alXxoDUox6bbRpWMtKT7nuyesTRfuJoFCi9aDCDUU2YEFCCQgt2lIgdGBzIroNk27OHQQzAS6j56L5ySHXjNV75yUfn897Eaav1UYT8J9AJdOd5dt-Fal7oehkEulLzcQl09aAnR4GOwhFD4jbxWQQ6BESBrn8B4C99jeG-1dZT8hwj1ZBTaReOdJXW5_3BqbzJVxi0hd4oeBc0x7Q8zhBjKEqLAe47hfieW_9-7ycAAP__fdZuVA)).
## America's Deadliest Beach Claims Ex-NFL QB
The deadliest beach in America is in Panama City, Fla., and it claimed three drowning victims last week, including [ex-NFL quarterback Ryan Mallet,](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxskb-O2zAMh59G3hQopGVLg4fk2mwput0Y6CwqZiFLB0l3bjr02Yu4S4dOvw8fAf4BX6-3q-PI6f7NrTS1kG9ubvxJNzVIsBLwBp2fAhEQdjQdB2MUjnrU3TJZBQOYcdQDmRGO6AE8obHgw1uwqDueQAGqAayyGgEOykDvbOiR7JFm1YtekeeWy-FH5tQWCvGRP6kc5rx2cVpae68CTwIuAi5toYVjfNYEXJa8UqKtCrj0alRGjTLEXNg7-UZuXmTKm_TkfGSqTXKSH1W2hat8kCvShUZFolxzIelL3hKne90HocDTb4GnRj-bwC8CzOv1fBZgBWhQAvRXEKDNkyzu7rtLbnU7vnB77HB-LiHg5Z_eGpRLfk-ff1H6q3LYo1CdP6h2ZfLvG8fIdRhFr-6r4_3krv3_O38CAAD__6OoiSo) who sets records as a college star at Arkansas. The Gulf beaches in that area, part of what Floridians call the "Redneck Riviera," are home to deadly riptides. Saturday alone saw 39 rescues, along with three deaths in a five-hour span. Sheriff Tommy Ford [expressed frustration](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxskLGO5CAQRL8GZ4xwgz04ILjE2Vx6oYWhsfuEwQJ2Rv77lTfeqEoqqfT0_r2Wl6VIaftrDzQt5MW6Rm9cxMhh4iAX6LwJiICyQ9OPWgv5HJ5Dtxs3hbVf0YfRWilxsL0G54MAtWoptOrIgAApRpjENEiAh9Cg7BSUxKlHJxRTAj21XB7_M6W2Y4hXfmN5uHx00eytnZXJPwxmBnO6zlzbPTGY72MGsxjvrhnMIeZC3vLVXtzlr9QuXncsFAJv-TguHnLxvNBZ-YrW7VvGUjltKRdKG__Yku6stKXKYO6K8eeHYqQ6PpkS22Ep_mC13y19BwAA___ormm6) at people's unwillingness to obey signs, danger flags, $500 fines, and lifeguard warnings in their zeal to swim. The area has seen seven deaths in the past nine days.

The Democrats spewed lies about how the bill would cut government spending, saying it would defund critical programs.

Ohio doesn’t need another two years with Congress members who obey orders to reject sensible government spending cuts that are desperately needed to address our national debt crisis!

Peter, I know I’m not the only frustrated American who wants politicians to stop forcing Big Government on us while putting it on our tab! Help me prove that I am not alone as I come down to the last 24 hours before my end of quarter fundraising goal!

# FROM THE DESK OF CHLOE COLE
---
|
---
Dear Friend,My name is Chloe.
---
| | You don't know me but I'm hoping you saw me on Fox News talking to Tucker Carlson.There are lots of powerful people who don't want my story to get out, so I'm so grateful that Mr. Carlson had me on as a guest.
---
| [](http://trk.libertyledger._dXRtX3NvdXJjZT1CREctUkVWJnV0bV9tZWRpdW09RU0mdXRtX2NhbXBhaWduPTIwMjMwNjI4X0JER19DRkFMX0NDU1BfUkVWX0FFLUxMTzA2MjkyMDIzIn0/eh2YLNJ1SukhZeBIossGtQ)
---
| | I guess I'm what you'd call a "cautionary tale."You see, I'm one of those girls who was deceived by the transgender movement.I'm 18 years old now but here is a picture of what I looked like before the transgender movement got me. And one from after -- when they had turned me into a "boy."
---
| | [](http://trk.libertyledger._dXRtX3NvdXJjZT1CREctUkVWJnV0bV9tZWRpdW09RU0mdXRtX2NhbXBhaWduPTIwMjMwNjI4X0JER19DRkFMX0NDU1BfUkVWX0FFLUxMTzA2MjkyMDIzIn0/Q8zN3EIzWR3po0MUMf8yvA)
---
**_Before transitioning_**
---
| [](http://trk.libertyledger._dXRtX3NvdXJjZT1CREctUkVWJnV0bV9tZWRpdW09RU0mdXRtX2NhbXBhaWduPTIwMjMwNjI4X0JER19DRkFMX0NDU1BfUkVWX0FFLUxMTzA2MjkyMDIzIn0/4764DwU2pLcTLq9xGVzY8Q)
---
** _After transitioning_**
---
| | [**Even though we don't know each other, I'm writing you today hoping you'll help me stop the** **horror of what happened to me, from happening to other children and their parents.**](http://trk.libertyledger._dXRtX3NvdXJjZT1CREctUkVWJnV0bV9tZWRpdW09RU0mdXRtX2NhbXBhaWduPTIwMjMwNjI4X0JER19DRkFMX0NDU1BfUkVWX0FFLUxMTzA2MjkyMDIzIn0/Wam-d3Kz14i0olPLQ8aShw) It all started when I was 11 years old and growing up in Northern California. I was growing embarrassed and confused once my body started changing.I was also shy and didn't socialize easily - and I didn't feel comfortable talking about any of this with my parents.But I found 'friends' on the internet who told me if I was uncomfortable with my body, I was probably a boy trapped in the wrong body.And the more I agreed with them, the more they celebrated me.I was getting the message loud and clear: if I was a girl who became a boy, I'd be valued and loved even more.Before long I was telling my parents I was transgender.They had no idea what to do.My poor parents were scared and desperate and took me to "experts" who convinced them that if they failed to act quickly, I would surely commit suicide.**The gender clinic gave my parents an ultimatum: "Would you rather have a dead daughter or a living son?"** Given those choices, my parents would have signed anything the doctors put in front of them if it meant "saving" me. When they signed those forms, it wasn't informed parental consent. It was a desperate decision made under extreme duress.And so, at age 13, I was fast-tracked for medical transition from a girl into a boy.[**Will you help me fight so these radical doctors and hospitals can't prey on another scared, confused, lonely child like they did me?**](http://trk.libertyledger._dXRtX3NvdXJjZT1CREctUkVWJnV0bV9tZWRpdW09RU0mdXRtX2NhbXBhaWduPTIwMjMwNjI4X0JER19DRkFMX0NDU1BfUkVWX0FFLUxMTzA2MjkyMDIzIn0/aA2x9y8PMn8zpVfIfW8p0A) The doctors started giving me weekly testosterone injections...they injected me with an experimental drug used to chemically castrate sex offenders......and finally, they removed my breasts in a radical double mastectomy.I was fifteen years old.And of course, none of this made me any happier or less confused.If you're like most people I tell my story to... right about now you're probably thinking, "HOW did it ever get this far?"And the answer is simple.The "experts" lied to my parents -- and to me -- every step of the way.They claimed I would never get "better" unless I medically transitioned - when the truth is that the vast majority of children who think they're transgender grow out of it with absolutely no chemical or surgical intervention.They claimed their consent forms covered all the risks of pumping testosterone and puberty blockers into my 13-year-old body......while their forms left out dozens and dozens of known risks.They never told us that there isn't one single scientific study on the effects these treatments have on young children.And they never, ever, were straight with me about what it would mean to let them remove my breasts.When I woke up from that surgery, I was shocked at how mangled my body was. And now years after the surgery, I still wear bandages every day to cover the oozing, unhealed scars.At age 18, I'm just beginning to understand what it will mean to never nurse my child -- if I'll ever be able to have children at all.For the rest of my life, my voice will sound like a man's, my body will look like a boy's, and who knows what cancers, cardiac problems, bone problems, and more are lurking around the corner.And my parents feel like they've failed me on every level imaginable.I can't go back. I can't change what happened.But I can change what happens to the THOUSANDS of kids just like me who are falling prey to the predatory transgender movement and unscrupulous abusive medical "experts." [**And YOU can help me.**](http://trk.libertyledger._dXRtX3NvdXJjZT1CREctUkVWJnV0bV9tZWRpdW09RU0mdXRtX2NhbXBhaWduPTIwMjMwNjI4X0JER19DRkFMX0NDU1BfUkVWX0FFLUxMTzA2MjkyMDIzIn0/Q3YwTYpH7RxUezmyn89TRg) More and more children are mutilated and abused every day.**There's even a doctor who advertises her mutilation surgeries on TikTok to draw young kids in.** And it won't stop until someone fights back.When I turned 18, I decided that someone would be me. I had no idea how I would do it, but I'd seen enough T.V. to know I needed a lawyer.I also didn't know how hard it would be to find someone willing to take my case in liberal California. didn't even know what a liberal was until they started slamming doors in my face!Finally, someone told me to call Harmeet Dhillon at the Center for American Liberty.
---
| | And the first time we spoke, I felt something I hadn't felt in a long time -- hope.Because Harmeet is a fighter like me.She didn't tell me we'd never win against the giant medical industry.She didn't tell me the transgender issue was too sensitive to touch.She told me my fight mattered.
---
| [](http://trk.libertyledger._dXRtX3NvdXJjZT1CREctUkVWJnV0bV9tZWRpdW09RU0mdXRtX2NhbXBhaWduPTIwMjMwNjI4X0JER19DRkFMX0NDU1BfUkVWX0FFLUxMTzA2MjkyMDIzIn0/7__Ak2Qe7LpBsc06s9BZog)
---
| | Not only because of what had happened to me -- but also because we could STOP it from happening to other children.And so together with Harmeet Dhillon's non-profit -- the Center for American Liberty -- I've launched a case against the radical doctors and hospital who preyed on me......and who continue to prey on children -- maybe even in your family.As I've mentioned several times -- I'm 18-years-old.On my own, I'd never have the money to pay for a giant court case like this.That's one of the ways these radicals are taking over everything. They know regular people like me don't have the money to fight them in court.But that's exactly why Harmeet started the Center for American Liberty.The Center for American Liberty brings together attorneys who want to fight for what's right and matches them with people like me who would have had nowhere else to turn.Right now, the Center for American Liberty has landmark cases going like:
---
* _Brach v. Newsom_ \-- to stop California from shutting down private and religious schools...
* _Ngo v. Roce City Antifa_ \-- to get justice for Andy Ngo after he was beaten by Antifa thugs and liberal politicians did NOTHING...
* _O'Handley v. Padilla_ \-- to stop Big Government from using Big Tech to silence people they disagree with...
* And now my case... _Chloe Cole v. Kaiser Permanente_.

---
The Center for American Liberty is a nonprofit. They have big cases but that doesn't mean they have the big money that their opponents have.[**That's why I hope you'll consider helping us by rushing back a small tax-deductible donation of $25 or more.**](http://trk.libertyledger._dXRtX3NvdXJjZT1CREctUkVWJnV0bV9tZWRpdW09RU0mdXRtX2NhbXBhaWduPTIwMjMwNjI4X0JER19DRkFMX0NDU1BfUkVWX0FFLUxMTzA2MjkyMDIzIn0/TUASa1-xnP_TcjNwejEJ1Q) There are big forces at work who want to get rich no matter who they hurt.Alone we're no match for them.[**But if everyone I'm writing to can contribute just $25, or if you're able, maybe more -- $35, $50, $75, $100, $200, or even $500**](http://trk.libertyledger._dXRtX3NvdXJjZT1CREctUkVWJnV0bV9tZWRpdW09RU0mdXRtX2NhbXBhaWduPTIwMjMwNjI4X0JER19DRkFMX0NDU1BfUkVWX0FFLUxMTzA2MjkyMDIzIn0/xj3LdoXpDB60Trbx8061jg), we can beat these monsters who are using scared, confused and lonely children to make a buck.For exposing them, I've been called a "liar." I've even been told de-transitioners like me don't exist. But when we beat them in court and stop them from hurting any more children with their lies and mutilations,I will be proud to face them and say:**_"You may have taken away my childhood, and forever changed my future -- but I exist. I exist."_** Thank you for reading this letter from a complete stranger. I hope I can call you a friend now.And thank you for whatever help you can send to the Center for American Liberty. **[Whether it's $25, $35, $50, $75, $100, $200, or even $500 or more...](http://trk.libertyledger._dXRtX3NvdXJjZT1CREctUkVWJnV0bV9tZWRpdW09RU0mdXRtX2NhbXBhaWduPTIwMjMwNjI4X0JER19DRkFMX0NDU1BfUkVWX0FFLUxMTzA2MjkyMDIzIn0/aFkRUhtsCFluai_Od5riig)** every bit moves us closer to stopping these monsters.
---
| | Thank you,Chloe Cole
---
| | [](http://trk.libertyledger.)
---
| P.S. This is a photo of me now. It's been a long, painful road but I'm finding happiness and purpose as I fight to make sure what happened to me NEVER happens to another child. **[Please help me with your tax-deductible gift of $25 or more.](http://trk.libertyledger.) **Thank you so much for your help. --Chloe

This is horrible, friend. **Three precious pups, the first wild-born in Colorado in over 80 years, were found SHOT TO DEATH just over the state border in Wyoming. So unless we act now, it's only a matter of time before the entire pack meets the same fate!**
Even though gray wolves have legal protections in Colorado, **they can still be SLAUGHTERED without consequence in pro-hunting states like Wyoming, just as these rare pups were. That means roaming their natural territory can quickly become a death sentence.**
Each death of this iconic species is a huge blow to decades of conservation efforts, and since a Trump-era rule rolled back federal protections for gray wolves, the trophy hunting lobby has pushed for even more cruel and inhumane laws throughout wolves’ natural habitats. **And even worse, the U.S. Fish and Wildlife Service could reinstate federal protections for these creatures – but has still failed to do so!**
**Now, violent shootings, choking snares and even helicopter chases are all acceptable hunting methods in states like Wyoming. That's why we urgently need your help to protect gray wolves – the ecosystems that rely on them an our planet – before it’s too late!**
We can’t stand aside while our wolves are under attack. That means we’re fighting with everything we have to protect the Endangered Species Act. The ESA allows us to shield endangered species from senseless violence, and also block destructive industries like Big Oil, logging and factory farming from destroying vital habitats for profits.
**If we demand immediate action today, we could stop this senseless attack on the lives and safety of gray wolves, protect this vital species for generations and fight for our planet. But first, we need to know where top supporters like you stand, friend. Saddam Azlan Salim is a first-generation immigrant born in Bangladesh. Growing up, he and his family experienced severe drought followed by the flood of 1998, the most extreme and long-lasting flood of the century in Bangladesh. He saw first-hand the damage caused by natural disasters as an 8-year-old boy. His father brought his family to America in 2000 so his kids could get a world class education and a better life.
Saddam believes in public service, because he has seen the real effects of affordable housing, healthcare, education and community support on his life. The City of Falls Church and Fairfax County helped his family survive and supported him through his education and career. Today, he wants to give back and serve that community. Help us elect a new kind of leader, who focuses on Virginia's future and the issues that matter!

Tomorrow night, our team will close the books on this quarter’s fundraising and start filing a report on our campaign finances for the Federal Election Commission. Shortly after that, those numbers will be made public for everyone to see. With a recent poll showing this race statistically tied, there’s no doubt that Mitch McConnell, potential Republican opponents, and their wealthy allies will be watching our numbers closely. If Republicans think we look weak, you can bet they will throw the kitchen sink at us to flip this toss-up seat — and the Senate — red. Unfortunately, our fundraising has slowed down quite a bit over the last few weeks and as of right now, we’re not on track to hit our target before the deadline. We can’t afford to fall short and send a weak fundraising report to the FEC, Peter, so I’m counting on this team to help us get back on track. [Can I count on you to split a donation between Blue Amp Action and my campaign $10 to help us defend this battleground seat and our Senate majority? | | | Dear Fellow American, Hillsdale College has selected you to participate in its [**National Referendum on the Administrative State**](https://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2zgjhkdglhejh5l5hcei71qc6lda30uqcq648meqo_rp22sh2s8i66o70s1imeoj3cjh2bs).
## Do you agree that there is a double standard for members of the administrative state—that the ruling elite is not required to follow the same rules as other Americans?
[YES](https://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2zdss99qvgriv4kq47p4q6k5iapa9g087v5lh6ab0_rp22sh2s8i66o70s1imeoj3cjh2bs) [NO](https://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2zd4n2ku36n0bqjdla8cvp8mpgi2nutoui3stcijg_rp22sh2s8i66o70s1imeoj3cjh2bs) Responding will only take a few minutes. Your input as an informed patriot is needed right away...because **our country is facing a constitutional crisis**.

It's a crisis that involves a fundamental political question: **who rules whom?**

The Constitution established a limited government in which the **people** ruled through their elected officials. Under this form of government, America became the freest and most prosperous nation in history.

Today, however, our constitutional system is one that increasingly exists in name only. **The Constitution of "We the People" is being replaced by an elite, out-of-touch, and unaccountable administrative state that rules without the consent of American citizens.** This means we live in an era of growing bureaucratic despotism, manifested in an administrative state that bypasses the Constitution, rejects the separation of powers, and replaces the rule of law with regulations.

**But we can 't just TALK about the problem. We also have to TAKE ACTION--to DO SOMETHING about it, while there's still time to save our country. **

That is why I'm writing to you today.

Hillsdale College is committed to returning to the Constitution of "We the People"--before it's too late.

To do that, I need your input. What are your opinions on this topic--knowing that we can propose SOLUTIONS that will restore liberty?

**Please let me know your thoughts today by answering the National Referendum on the Administrative State using this secure link:**

**[https://lp.hillsdale.edu/administrative-state-survey/](https://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2zdq10hfd0807rhkq1ru7lup590q0hne5a3i62pb0_rp22sh2s8i66o70s1imeoj3cjh2bs)**

Thank you for being on the side of the Constitution and liberty!

Warm regards,

Larry P. Arnn
President, Hillsdale College
Pursuing Truth and Defending Liberty Since 1844

Friends of the Earth is fighting to protect our planet -- and our futures -- from the greatest threats we've ever known. That means we're speaking truth to power, taking on **selfish and destructive** corporations, and pressuring our leaders to take the **urgent action** we need in this moment of crisis. _**To help continue this work, a generous group of donors is matching every gift we receive through June 30, up to our $150,000 End of Fiscal Year goal.**_ But before we make our general announcement to the whole community, we're reaching out to top supporters like you – because we know that you are as committed to this fight as every member of our core team. **Your support is needed now more than ever. To make your giving as convenient as possible, we've created a custom link, specifically for you. If you can, please consider making a larger donation this year -- will you give $27 or more now and have your gift matched to help reach our must-hit goal and continue the fight to save our only Earth? Here is your personalized link** : | [SPECIAL MATCH ACCESS FOR dpwillis67@gmail.com](https://us.engagingnetworks.app/page/email/click/10012/1851339?email=RepJ2ZGQKX6xm5Aey7FwClESkN1MQhKC&campid=UI6tX83ZqbKZkArzVWMSmA==)
---
I know that this fight can seem overwhelming, but supporters like you are powering our efforts to stop the worst impact of the climate crisis, transition to a just and sustainable food system, protect our oceans and waterways, and protect precious species from extinction. **And our efforts are working. You helped Friends of the Earth to: **
* Work with the Tlingit, Haida, and Tsimshian people to reinstate Roadless Rule protections across the Tongass National Forest in Alaska, prohibiting road buildings to access remote corners of the forest, protecting over 9 million acres from industrial logging.
* Put pressure on the U.S. Nuclear Regulatory Commission (NRC) to decline reviewing Pacific Gas & Electric's outdated license renewal application for its dangerous Diablo Canyon nuclear power plant. Now, Diablo must submit an updated and complete application if it wants an extension. We are continuing to fight Diablo's extension to protect local communities and sea life.
* Supported local Yuman-speaking tribes in their fight to gain National Monument designation for Avi Kwa Ame in Nevada, winning protections for this culturally and ecologically important area.

Those are just a few of the fights we've won together. So we simply can't slow our efforts now. With your support, we are building vital momentum to hold Big Polluters accountable and win the crucial fights we have ahead. [**We know that we can count on you, because you recognize how high the stakes are. So please: Will you make an early membership donation today to help reach our must-hit $150,000 End of Fiscal Year goal? Reproductive freedoms, voting rights, environmental protections, and healthcare access are all on the line in Pennsylvania – and much more. A strong, experienced, and capable Attorney General is often the last line of defense to protect our rights.

There are many scandalous stories surrounding Hunter Biden's infamous laptop, which has been dubbed "The Laptop From Hell" by many, including President Trump. In an effort to distract from the Hunter Biden laptop scandal, the mainstream media and some Democrat politicians have described the "laptop from hell" as being [Russian disinformation](https://link.sbstck.com/redirect/43b3dca5-d96c-4104-83b6-9822c6374ee0?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg). As we no know thanks to testimony made in front of the US House Judiciary Committee, ["Former CIA Deputy Director Michael Morrell testified before the House Judiciary and Intelligence Committees, and revealed that Secretary of State Antony Blinken was "the impetus" of the public statement signed in October 2020 that implied the laptop belonging to Hunter Biden was disinformation."](https://link.sbstck.com/redirect/0570c8f7-9fb9-4ff1-bb14-51182c9fd4ed?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
Over 50 intelligence officials signed a letter which falsely stated that Hunter Biden's laptop "has all the classic earmarks of a Russian information operation." However, we now know that is far from the truth, as it [has been revealed by an IRS whistleblower ](https://link.sbstck.com/redirect/8c0139af-66de-409e-a44e-85831f18a407?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)that the FBI verified the authenticity of Hunter Biden's laptop in 2019, but chose to sit on it for the duration of the 2020 election in an effort to not harm Joe Biden's Presidential election.
Now that we know the media and the intelligence officials were wrong or even lying, it begs the question...what else are they keeping from the public, and what else are they hiding?
Prior to the laptop surfacing, Reuters [reported](https://link.sbstck.com/redirect/bf21c7ee-5733-423f-be3e-22ad1eba3d2c?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg),
> "Biden's role at Burisma Holdings Ltd has come under intense scrutiny following unsupported accusations by U.S. President Donald Trump that Joe Biden improperly tried to help his son's business interests in Ukraine."
Those "unsupported claims" by President Trump ultimately turned out to be true.
Now the media has been forced to come to the realization that coordinated lies were told, narratives were spun, all in an effort to protect Joe Biden and mitigate a controversy regarding his son's illegal and unethical business dealings, which Joe Biden himself helped play a role in facilitating.
And as the focus of the Hunter Biden laptop scandal has been focused on Hunter's business dealings with China and Ukraine, a key factor of the scandal has gone unreported by the media in an effort to distract from a disturbing investment that Hunter Biden made called _**Metabiota.**_
Why doesn't the media want to talk about Hunter Biden's investment into MetaBiota?
**Rosemont Seneca**
| [](https://link.sbstck.com/redirect/1e4f03a6-346e-47bb-9a75-f534034c0cae?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|

In 2009, Hunter Biden, Devon Archer, and Christopher Heinz founded the investment and advisory firm **Rosemont Seneca Partners**. One of Rosemont Seneca's key investments in February of 2014 was Metabiota. The first initial investment they made into MetaBiota was for $250,000. An [email](https://link.sbstck.com/redirect/7e6ba1aa-cdfa-409c-bc2c-706883104727?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) from John DeLoche, the Managing Director of Rosemont Seneca Technology Partners highlights a dinner and conversation with Nathan Wolfe, the founder of Metabiota.
As the email to Hunter Biden, DeLoche said,
> "We had a great dinner with Nathan and Robert from Metabiota last night. They are looking to do a series A in a few months which may allow us to mark up our investment to 5x what we paid. They are digitizing the microbial world; what Palantir is to the CIA, Metabiota is the USDA."
One of the key points of this dinner was to use Hunter Biden as a proxy for Metabiota to get contracts from DHS and the Department of Defense since a the time, Joe Biden, Hunter's father, was the Vice President of the United States under the administration of Barrack Obama. As the relationship evolved, emails also reveal that Metabiota wanted help from Rosemont Seneca to conduct business in Ukraine.
In an [email](https://link.sbstck.com/redirect/6cf65854-45dd-441c-a983-e904020b17dd?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) that was sent to Hunter Biden and several of his partners at Rosemont Seneca from Mary Guttieri, the Vice President of Science and Technology Administration at Metabiota, she highlighted that it would be beneficial to "assert Ukraine's cultural and economic independence from Russia." This came at a time when Vice President Biden was in charge of Ukrainian relations.
| [](https://link.sbstck.com/redirect/1fb296bc-44bf-4171-bf7a-231c622597ae?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
The investment flourished when Hunter Biden convinced Goldman Sachs to get involved. In an [email](https://link.sbstck.com/redirect/5ce840cf-8b6c-4e28-8b95-5f3c94ea25d9?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) by John DeLoche, he said,
> "Just spoke to Goldman. They want to find a way to come into the fund for $5mm-$10 million (bringing our GS assets to up to $60mm) and also do a direct co-invest in Metabiota."
Hunter Biden knew the importance of this investment when it was stressed that Metabiota will be "more and more important with global awareness of Pandemic threats."
| [](https://link.sbstck.com/redirect/c00c5ad7-c238-446c-8030-0bba2d2a7bec?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
The business deals in Ukraine by Hunter had a secrecy element involved that Devon Archer [highlighted](https://link.sbstck.com/redirect/6b050c0c-9bfd-482c-93ea-1f6502cd3d2c?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) in another email he sent to Hunter Biden. The secrecy surrounding Hunter Biden's board role was due to the fact that his father at the time was Vice President of the United States. In the email, Archer said,
> "Spent 60 minutes on the phone with Vadim today. They are in complete agreement in regards to the discrete nature of your Board role and they actually described the same before I repeated it. People will discover this though from corporate filings or one way or another so we have to be ready for questions."
Regardless of the fact that these emails reveal a deliberate effort to conceal Hunter's shady business ties and the use of his fathers influence to secure lucrative investments into a company that focuses on pandemics, the mainstream media is not asking Joe Biden or his son any questions about Metabiota.

## Metabiota
Metabiota was founded in 2008 by Nathan Wolfe in San Francisco, California. According to their [website](https://link.sbstck.com/redirect/49e1ed5c-2f86-4ca1-aa4b-51af10eae9e0?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), Metabiota
> "harnesses data science, provides analytical tools, and delivers hand-on support, helping governments and businesses around the world mitigate and transfer the health and economic risks posed by infectious diseases. The company is widely recognized in the public and private sectors, having helped push the boundaries of insuring catastrophic risks, preparing for infectious disease threats and catalyzing public-private partnerships to protect global health security."
| [](https://link.sbstck.com/redirect/3835ed8c-b7af-4dc7-8c9c-28aeaaeee49c?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
Prior to Hunter Biden's involvement in Metabiota, the United States government gave them a contract for $649,882. After Hunter Biden's involvement with the board of Metabiota, US government spending records reveal that the Department of Defense awarded an $18.4 million contract to Metabiota between February 2014 and November 2016 (while Joe Biden was Vice President), with $307,091 earmarked for 'Ukraine research projects'.
| [](https://link.sbstck.com/redirect/ff1c0fb1-3814-44e4-8cb7-ca39c0878141?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
What's important to remember is at the time these emails were sent in 2014, the world was facing a very serious threat to global public health when Ebola was spreading in West Africa at an alarming rate. At one point in 2016, data shows suspected and confirmed cases had totaled more than 28,600. For this reason, the United States government thought it was a good idea to give Metabiota millions of dollars to contain Ebola.
Prior to the Ebola outbreak, Vice President Biden had a history of combatting the very threat of diseases. The first disease that Biden aggressively kept focus on was the H1N1, the swine flu, which was spreading rapidly during the Obama administration. He was so aggressive in his approach, that he called on people to quit traveling via bus or plane. A Politico [report](https://link.sbstck.com/redirect/6769c120-5569-4a3c-ad11-33524b66962d?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) by Natasha Korecki states,
> "Transportation Secretary Ray LaHood, Homeland Security Secretary Janet Napolitano and Deputy Secretary of State Jack Lew were summoned to the White House and assigned to clean up the mess Biden made: "Nip it in the bud," LaHood said, recalling their instructions."
Now that we know that Biden has had a history of being in power during pandemics, his expertise was needed with the Ebola crisis. In 2014, President Obama appointed Ron Klain, Vice President Joe **Biden** 's former chief of staff as the Ebola Czar. Klain was the guy behind choosing Metabiota to contain the Ebola virus. Was Metabiota successful?
According to a CBS [article](https://link.sbstck.com/redirect/2bd6fd87-a59b-454d-988b-68b3011847aa?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), "WHO outbreak expert Dr. Eric Bertherat wrote to colleagues in a July 17, 2014, email about misdiagnoses and "total confusion" at the Sierra Leone government lab Metabiota shared with Tulane University in the city of Kenema. He said there was "no tracking of the samples" and "absolutely no control on what is being done."
It's odd that a company that collected samples of this virus did not track the samples that were being collected. In the end, American tax payers didn't end up paying Metabiota millions of dollars to contain a virus, they paid them millions of dollars to bungle the response.
In a scathing review of Metabiota's job performance, [the CBS article goes on to explain,](https://link.sbstck.com/redirect/2bd6fd87-a59b-454d-988b-68b3011847aa?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
> "In Sierra Leone, Sylvia Blyden, who served as Special Executive Assistant to the country's President in the early days of the outbreak, said Metabiota's response was a disaster. "They messed up the entire region," she said. She called Metabiota's attempt to claim credit for its Ebola work "an insult for the memories of thousands of Africans who have died."
Despite the poor performance by Metabiota, the United States continued to give tax payer money to Metabiota to handle future pandemics and track the spread of these viruses.
**Global Pandemic Insurance**
Metabiota's successes in keeping the public safe from harmful viruses may have been limited. However, their pandemic insurance was a success.
| [](https://link.sbstck.com/redirect/d6637662-5a98-49db-85e9-dfdd26735f99?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
In an [email](https://link.sbstck.com/redirect/caa6243f-3269-4a8c-85d7-d3a9f1f052e3?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) to Hunter Biden from Rosemont Seneca employee Neil Callahan, he wrote to William Lee,
> "So a buddy of mine runs a consulting firm that does corporate strategy and assurance type work - one of his case studies is "Pandemic Preparedness" his clients include Goldman, Pfizer, Merck - Fortune 100 types."
Given what we now know about the COVID-19 pandemic, one has to ask the question, did this pandemic insurance consist of these companies creating and selling a vaccine on the taxpayers dime under the guise of "Pandemic Preparedness"?
Regardless of the failures or successes of Metabiota, Hunter Biden's investment into Metabiota was very lucrative. No matter how you spin this investment, the fact is that Hunter Biden clearly profited from COVID-19 and the millions of dollars of Metabiota government contracts that were granted to Metabiota while Hunter Biden's father was Vice President. And perhaps he will continue to profit off of future investments while his father is in the White House.
It is rather interesting that Hunter Biden invested into Metabiota, a company that claims to be managing, stopping, and preventing epidemics by working closely with local health authorities worldwide, "supporting them in their efforts to better serve their communities through expanded and improved surveillance, laboratory, and response capacities".
Is Hunter Biden a genius investor, or did he know something beforehand from his father's position as Vice President that prompted him to invest in a Pandemic response company?

subject: How should we elect the president?
body:
http://paracom.paramountcommunication.com/p/vs-QfKBDNe

A movement is growing, led by progressives-but supported by many
well-meaning Americans-to change the way we elect our president.

http://paracom.paramountcommunication.com/p/os-QfKBDNe

Please see a special message from our
sponsor:

Dear
Fellow American,

I am
enclosing a survey on a very urgent matter.

It will
only take a moment of your time, but the topic is vital to our
nation's future.

A
movement is growing, led by progressives-but supported by many
well-meaning Americans-to change the way we elect our president.
In effect, it seeks to do away with the Electoral College as
devised by the Framers of our Constitution.

That's
why Hillsdale College is conducting a National Survey on
Presidential Selection.

By
completing this survey and returning it to me as soon as
possible, you will help Hillsdale College more clearly understand
the views of mainstream Americans concerning this issue-views we
will make available to policymakers and opinion leaders.

You can
complete the National Survey on Presidential Selection by using
the link below:
http://paracom.paramountcommunication.com/ct/61971261:s-QfKBDNe:m:3:2532013465:F858AE7FC42B99E89F82B8EFC434126D:r

Do you
think that most Americans understand how the Electoral College
works and its role in preserving free and representative
government?
YES
NO

For most
of our nation's history, the Electoral College, as devised by the
Framers of our Constitution, was not controversial. Indeed, it
was considered essential to preserving free and representative
government.

But
today, more than a dozen states have joined together in an
attempt to undermine this constitutional bulwark of liberty.

This
movement to undermine the Constitution has grown largely because
of the failure of America's schools to provide young people with
a proper grounding in American civics-too many Americans simply
don't understand the importance of the Constitution, including
the Electoral College, to liberty.

Because
of this, Hillsdale College has expanded its educational mission
on behalf of liberty nationwide, directly teaching millions of
Americans in all 50 states.

These
efforts, which aim to counter the Left's domination over most of
our schools, include:

Teaching millions of citizens nationwide through free online
courses, such as "Constitution 101" and "The Great American
Story: A Land of Hope;"

Reaching over six million households and businesses nationwide
with Imprimis, Hillsdale's free digest of liberty;

Promoting constitutional education through social media outlets
popular with young people;

Sending millions of pocket-size copies of America's founding
documents to citizens and K-12 schools across America; and

Restoring excellence to K-12 education by helping establish and
guiding classical K-12 schools nationwide and providing, free of
charge, Hillsdale's American classical K-12 curriculum (including
American civics) to thousands of American educators and
homeschoolers.

Your
answers to the National Survey on Presidential Selection will
help Hillsdale form the most effective strategy to educate
millions of Americans about the importance of the Constitution to
liberty-including the importance of the Electoral College.

And this
is especially important in this critical time for America's
future.

So please
share your views on this urgent topic by completing our National
Survey on Presidential Selection and returning it to me as soon
as possible. It will only take a few minutes of your time.

You can
take the survey using this secure link I've provided below:
http://paracom.paramountcommunication.com/ct/61971261:s-QfKBDNe:m:3:2532013465:F858AE7FC42B99E89F82B8EFC434126D:r

And after
you take your survey, I hope you will also consider supporting
Hillsdale College with a tax-deductible gift.

Since
1844, Hillsdale has been "pursuing truth and defending liberty."
Today, it does so through its extensive educational outreach
efforts while refusing to accept ONE PENNY of government
funding-not even indirectly in the form of federal or state
student grants or loans.

The
support of private citizens like you is essential to our work.

Please
represent your state and take the National Survey on Presidential
Selection today. Thank you for your time and attention-and for
your friendship and support of liberty.

Warm
regards,

Larry P.
Arnn

President, Hillsdale College
Pursuing
Truth and Defending Liberty Since 1844

| Dear Fellow American,

As an informed conservative, surely you know how Judicial Watch works hard every day to fight _for_ the rule of law and _against_ public corruption and unlawful government secrecy...
...and you know that in these fights _every dollar counts_.
**[That’s why I urge you to join Judicial Watch with a special donation today!](https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=63959&L=17813&F=H&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuanVkaWNpYWx3YXRjaC5vcmcvZG9uYXRlL3RoYW5rLXlvdS0xMzUvP3V0bV9zb3VyY2U9ZGVwbG95ZXImdXRtX21lZGl1bT1lbWFpbCZ1dG1fY29udGVudD1BTWpjd09EazVOVFElM0QmdXRtX2NhbXBhaWduPU1heSZ1dG1fdGVybT1Ob24tRG9ub3Jz&hash=a27e3dffa06e173a0004e320eb691911825abcdbc43a80e551b7336d53a8f580)**

I am asking you to for your support today because the impact of our work has never been more important!

* **_We continue to be the most effective voice in the country for commonsense safeguards to keep our elections honest_****.**

Just this year, we have successfully settled our National Voter Registration Act lawsuits against **Colorado** and **Pennsylvania** after those states cleaned their voter rolls of hundreds of thousands of ineligible voters... _the very best way to counter voter fraud_!

* **_We continue to be the most effective voice in the country for the American people 's "right to know" what our government is up to_****.**

It's easy to _complain_ about Biden administration secrecy, _but we go to court_ and force the release of public records the American people have a right to see... _like stunning documents showing US grant dollars that went to the Wuhan Institute of Virology in China may have been responsible for the emergence of the Covid pandemic_!

And we recently appeared before the Delaware Supreme Court in our ongoing lawsuit against the University of Delaware for access to the secret U.S. Senate records of President Joe Biden. _We have dug in for the legal long haul to answer the question_ ... _what is Joe Biden hiding_?

Our work and its impact is widespread...

[...and the special support we receive from supporters is essential to our success.](https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=63959&L=17813&F=H&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuanVkaWNpYWx3YXRjaC5vcmcvZG9uYXRlL3RoYW5rLXlvdS0xMzUvP3V0bV9zb3VyY2U9ZGVwbG95ZXImdXRtX21lZGl1bT1lbWFpbCZ1dG1fY29udGVudD1BTWpjd09EazVOVFElM0QmdXRtX2NhbXBhaWduPU1heSZ1dG1fdGVybT1Ob24tRG9ub3Jz&hash=a27e3dffa06e173a0004e320eb691911825abcdbc43a80e551b7336d53a8f580)

[Contribute](https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=63959&L=17813&F=H&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuanVkaWNpYWx3YXRjaC5vcmcvZG9uYXRlL3RoYW5rLXlvdS0xMzUvP3V0bV9zb3VyY2U9ZGVwbG95ZXImdXRtX21lZGl1bT1lbWFpbCZ1dG1fY29udGVudD1BTWpjd09EazVOVFElM0QmdXRtX2NhbXBhaWduPU1heSZ1dG1fdGVybT1Ob24tRG9ub3Jz&hash=a27e3dffa06e173a0004e320eb691911825abcdbc43a80e551b7336d53a8f580)
---

Because when it comes to defending our nation's election laws, battling unlawful government secrecy, and standing firm for the rule of law, the need for quick Judicial Watch action through the courts can often arise suddenly and without warning.

Backed by Joe Biden, the Left is corruptly using its power to radically transform America. And our investigations and lawsuits prove that the Left will use any tool, including unlawful government secrecy and censorship of conservative voices to achieve their goals.

Frankly, I fear our Republic is teetering from persistent attacks by the organized Left, by the Biden administration, and by corrupt politicians of both parties.

I can think of no group better able to counter these forces, educate the public and defend our threatened U.S. Constitution than your Judicial Watch through our full arsenal of independent investigations, lawsuits and other legal actions.

And there's no question that your support is a critical cornerstone in allowing us to continue to be the most effective conservative government watchdog group in America.

[That's why I hope you will make your best tax-deductible gift today so we can continue to respond effectively as we fight for you and for America.](https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=63959&L=17813&F=H&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuanVkaWNpYWx3YXRjaC5vcmcvZG9uYXRlL3RoYW5rLXlvdS0xMzUvP3V0bV9zb3VyY2U9ZGVwbG95ZXImdXRtX21lZGl1bT1lbWFpbCZ1dG1fY29udGVudD1BTWpjd09EazVOVFElM0QmdXRtX2NhbXBhaWduPU1heSZ1dG1fdGVybT1Ob24tRG9ub3Jz&hash=a27e3dffa06e173a0004e320eb691911825abcdbc43a80e551b7336d53a8f580)

Thomas Fitton

Hey folks, happy Thursday!
I wanted to take a moment to tell you a bit about why I’m in this fight.
I’m not the kind of guy you’d expect to see in Congress. I still get $12 flattop haircuts. And at home on the farm, I butcher my own meat.
I didn’t come to Washington to play into partisan hogwash – I came because I didn’t see anyone in our government sticking up for rural communities like mine.

Nationwide, our candidates are fulfilling their promises and making life better for hard-working American families.
**IN OKLAHOMA, MAJOR WINS ARE COMING SOONER THAN LATER**
For example, in Oklahoma, Republican Gov Kevin Stitt recently [approved](https://link.sbstck.com/redirect/c0702744-71a7-4d85-b2bb-c157fef2f957?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) historic, groundbreaking education rules **spearheaded by state Superintendent Ryan Walters** , **a candidate endorsed by our PAC.**
The new rules allow the Oklahoma Board of Education to downgrade the accreditation status of schools that allow their libraries to carry sexually explicit reading materials and distribute them to students.
And that's not all, the rules give parents a say in what their kids are actually reading, and ban teachers from secretly using a different pronoun or gender without parents' knowledge.
Just like we told you when we announced our endorsement, Ryan Walters stands up for parents and children against dangerous far-left indoctrination.

**PARENTS AND STUDENTS ARE THE TOP PRIORITY**
In Ohio, the state House this month [passed](https://link.sbstck.com/redirect/0ccbb495-ddb1-40db-bd64-2be58159f6ca?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) the Parents' Bill of Rights, which acknowledges a fundamental tenet of our platform - That parents should have a say in their kids' education.
This means that teachers unions or far-left radicals can't hide their indoctrination efforts.
It means there's transparency in the curriculum, so parents know what their kids are being taught.
And most importantly, it means that there's a process in place for parents to express their concerns, have potential violations addressed, and be able to seek a remedy for harms done to their children.
And here at 1776 Project PAC, we've been one step ahead on all of this. Last summer in Kansas, our endorsed candidates on the **Lansing School Board, Amy Covey, Jeff Collin, and Mary Wood** , [passed](https://link.sbstck.com/redirect/3098339c-fa72-42d7-b0b0-8ba1cb1fda66?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) one of the most comprehensive parental rights bills in the country.
This bill of rights ensures that PARENTS direct their child's education and upbringing, and grants parents the right to request, access, and inspect all written and electronic records maintained by a school relating to students.
And when teachers or administrators cross the line, parents have a course of action to hold them accountable.

For example, we learned just this month that average test scores for 13-year-olds in America have [cratered](https://link.sbstck.com/redirect/ebe553bd-0237-4308-8b93-171f4479fe1a?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) to their lowest levels in decades.
And sadly, it's often students in some of the country's most vulnerable communities who suffer the most from left-wing efforts to push extremist ideology in the classroom and destroy the dignity of a balanced education.
It's why the work we're doing here at 1776 Project PAC is more important - and more consequential - than it's ever been.
We can't surrender our kids' future to these far-left radicals.
We can't cede control of our schools to out-of-control administrators.
And we certainly can't afford to waste another minute letting the left control school curriculum.
We're making major progress.

name: Tim Sheehy
subject: Send in the SEAL
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY TIM SHEEHY FOR MONTANA
body:
I’ve fought and bled for America. Now, I’m looking to take my fight to the U.S. Senate.

|
---
[](https://click.youramerica.news/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=653%7c27782%7c920805%7c0%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=0ZhWA7G3kfBak3M%2fTa7AKg&sysid=1)

Fellow Conservative,

My name is Tim Sheehy - I'm a former Navy SEAL, founder of a veteran aerial firefighting company that employs hundreds of Montanans, father of four beautiful kids, husband, and an American patriot.

I'll never forget how I felt on 9/11. That fateful day motivated me to serve, and now I'm answering the call again. America needs true conservative leaders who will step-up and serve our GREAT nation. **My next mission is to defeat Liberal Democrat Senator Jon Tester and end his near quarter century political career.**

[**chip in any amount
Send a Navy SEAL to the Senate**](https://click.youramerica.news/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=653%7c27783%7c920805%7c0%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=y8Oo5V5lIHGi1D093YbqvA&sysid=1)
You don't know me yet, although I hope to change that today, but you do know what I stand for as a Navy SEAL; I've fought for you, for our freedoms and liberties, to protect and defend our nation from those who wish to do us harm.

Career politicians like Democrat Jon Tester, **who has been in elected office for nearly 25 years** , are not getting the job done. **[That's why I'm challenging him for his seat in the United States Senate.](https://click.youramerica.news/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=653%7c27784%7c920805%7c0%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=jbRNkvuCfFTXNa6yK6Kmxw&sysid=1) **

**As a Navy SEAL, I fought and bled for this country - _and considering our crippling debt, open borders, and woke culture_ ** [**I'm prepared to sacrifice even more of myself for the betterment of all Americans.**](https://click.youramerica.news/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=653%7c27795%7c920805%7c0%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=3hvvr%2fj5y1dZLtwLiDaeuQ&sysid=1)

We need strong leaders who will solve problems and put Montana - and America - FIRST.

When I joined the Navy, I made a commitment not only to myself, but to my country. Our country. Those of you reading this today who served in the Armed Forces will know that the commitment we made to America when we joined up isn't just for four, six, or even 20 years - it's lifelong.

[**My mission continues in a different way now, and I'm asking you to support me not only with your prayers, but with your financial backing, too.**](https://click.youramerica.news/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=653%7c27796%7c920805%7c0%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=4Qz%2f9v3vdr4oQ59JrcvcCQ&sysid=1)

[**SEND IN THE SEAL
CHIP IN TODAY**](https://click.youramerica.news/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=653%7c27783%7c920805%7c0%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=y8Oo5V5lIHGi1D093YbqvA&sysid=1)
During my time as a Navy SEAL, I was deployed to Iraq, Afghanistan, South America, and the Pacific - I've been involved in dozens of engagements with enemy forces.

But, running to be Montana's next U.S. Senator will be the toughest mission yet.

**Just look at where we are as a nation.** Since Joe Biden took office our once strong economy is no longer what it once was as we experience skyrocketing inflation, our borders are more porous than ever before, and the woke culture of the Left is tearing apart the very fabric of our society.

_**I cannot - and will not - remain quiet when I know I can be of service to you and your family in the U.S. Senate.**_

[**I've been training for this moment my entire life, Fellow Conservative.**](https://click.youramerica.news/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=653%7c27797%7c920805%7c0%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=Il6FTbcE5TlCZjzXpohbSw&sysid=1)

To accomplish this mission, it's going to take all of America working together as a TEAM. Our adversary is well-armed and has well insulated himself against attacks over his three-term career in D.C. That's why I'm going to be counting on having the best possible team around me to successfully navigate the terrain. [**Are you up for the task?**](https://click.youramerica.news/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=653%7c27798%7c920805%7c0%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=3bqmCUYDCGrQvHAMiFEiNw&sysid=1)

[**SEND IN THE SEAL
CHIP IN TODAY**](https://click.youramerica.news/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=653%7c27783%7c920805%7c0%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=y8Oo5V5lIHGi1D093YbqvA&sysid=1)
I'm aware that this isn't going to be an easy race to win; you don't see people lining up to take on incumbents very often because truthfully, it isn't the easy thing to do. But as they say in the SEALS, _"nobody remembers a loser or a quitter."_

_**I can tell you this right now:[I'm going to be remembered as the guy who took down Jon Tester.](https://click.youramerica.news/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=653%7c27799%7c920805%7c0%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=cRA0CaNBVXU6EreIIEsaRQ&sysid=1) **_

[**Please, if you can, do me a favor and chip in $5, $10, $15 or even $25 right now.**](https://click.youramerica.news/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=653%7c27790%7c920805%7c0%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=I5DW6JBrJk7syg2xDWXsqw&sysid=1)

We need real, competent leadership to save our country and protect the American Dream for future generations.

Montana can do better.

America can do better.

You deserve better.

Our veterans, my friends that didn't make it home, fought for better.

[**Join me.**](https://click.youramerica.news/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=653%7c27791%7c920805%7c0%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=nFie8b0e8FhZOdd8SRib%2bQ&sysid=1)

Hooyah,

Tim Sheehy
Former Navy SEAL
Republican for U.S. Senate

[**SEND IN THE SEAL
CHIP IN TODAY **](https://click.youramerica.news/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=653%7c27783%7c920805%7c0%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=y8Oo5V5lIHGi1D093YbqvA&sysid=1)

|
* * *

“
"I SERVED AS A NAVY SEAL, BUILT ONE OF THE LARGEST AERIAL FIREFIGHTING COMPANIES IN AMERICA CREATING OVER 200 MONTANA JOBS, AND STARTED A VETERAN-LED CATTLE RANCHING AND FEEDING OPERATION. WHETHER IT WAS IN WAR OR BUSINESS, I SEE PROBLEMS AND SOLVE THEM. AMERICA NEEDS CONSERVATIVE LEADERS WHO LOVE OUR COUNTRY. I'M RUNNING FOR THE U.S. SENATE BECAUSE OUR CAMPAIGN IS ABOUT SERVICE, DUTY, AND COUNTRY -- NOT POLITICS AS USUAL."

[](https://click.youramerica.news/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=653%7c27783%7c920805%7c0%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=y8Oo5V5lIHGi1D093YbqvA&sysid=1)

name: Lacey (sent from my iPhone)
subject: bumping Katie’s email
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Katie Porter for Senate
body:
Hi, Derek! It’s Lacey, Katie Porter’s Campaign Manager.
Katie reached out to you on Tuesday, and I want to make sure you caught her email. Here’s what you need to know:
We hit an important FEC fundraising deadline tomorrow at midnight. Remember, we were outraised last quarter. That means the stakes couldn’t be higher this time around.
Reporters are already asking if Katie has the grassroots support to compete and win. So, it’s really important we post strong numbers. If we raise a lot, it will send a powerful message about the viability and strength of Katie’s campaign—not only to our opponents and the media but also to voters.
If you’re able to step up and add in a donation today to show your support, it’ll mean so much to Katie and to the success of our campaign.
[**https://secure.actblue.com/donate/kp4s-em-20230629-1**](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/kp4s-em-20230629-1?refcode=EMAI29_1_PLA_20230629_V1_F&refcode2=25667_3422442_wWNlDb&akid=25667%2E3422442%2EwWNlDb)
Thank you!
Lacey M.
Campaign Manager
(sent from my iPhone)
_\---------- Forwarded message ---------
From: Katie Porter
Date: Tuesday, June 27, 2023
Subject: Recent reporter question
To: Derek [dpwillis67@gmail.com]_
Derek,
Katie Porter here. In a recent TV interview, I was asked if I had the fundraising power needed to run statewide here in California.
People are wondering if our team has the strength to go the distance because last quarter we were outraised by _two million dollars._ It’s not because our opponent has thousands more supporters. We pulled in more money than any other candidate in small-dollar donations, but because of big checks and “max-out” contributions, he outraised us.
And because I don’t take a dime from corporate PACs, federal lobbyists, or Big Oil, Big Pharma, or Big Bank CEOs, some have said we don’t have a chance of catching up.
**Here’s the deal: I know that’s BS. I’m confident our grassroots team has what it takes to fuel this campaign and win. Can you help prove the strength of our movement and chip in $15 today?** Here’s a link: [**https://secure.actblue.com/donate/kp4s-em-20230627-1**](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/kp4s-em-20230629-1?refcode=EMAI29_1_PLA_20230629_V1_F&refcode2=25667_3422442_wWNlDb&akid=25667%2E3422442%2EwWNlDb)
One of my favorite campaign activities is calling our grassroots supporters at random and saying thank you—getting to hear from the baristas and teachers and electricians who power our campaign, giving what they can, when they can.
Our campaign’s fundraising is operating in a way that might be unique, and that’s because I’m not just another career politician in Washington. I’m a single mom who ran for office when Trump came to power—and I’m here to shake up the status quo, hold corporations accountable, and deliver for working people.
**Our end of quarter deadline is this Friday, and everyone's watching to see if we’ll be outraised once again.** This week is incredibly consequential for our campaign. I’d be so appreciative if you could make a contribution [**https://secure.actblue.com/donate/kp4s-em-20230627-1**](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/kp4s-em-20230629-1?refcode=EMAI29_1_PLA_20230629_V1_F&refcode2=25667_3422442_wWNlDb&akid=25667%2E3422442%2EwWNlDb)
Thanks so much,
Katie
