I fight everyday in Congress to advocate for the people of mid-Michigan. I’m working to lower costs and to create good-paying jobs. I’m working to improve infrastructure, make prescription drugs and health care more affordable, and protect Social Security and Medicare.

**And, one year after the Supreme Court decision to overturn Roe v. Wade, I’m still fighting in Congress for federal protections for abortion and to protect your right to make your own health care decisions.**

While some of my colleagues seemingly are constantly distracted by petty politics and hoping for news airtime, I’m in Congress to lower the temperature of politics and to get _results_ for Michiganders.

**_That’s what Michiganders need: results, not extremist rhetoric and partisan games._

[Can you chip in $15 before our deadline so we can prove our grassroots strength when our numbers go public?](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/65615657/414019198/-630748219?amount=15&source=EM_NBI_DK_20230629_FR_1.6_0_12MO_T_candidate_NA_NA_eoq.rs&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDcvMS83Nzg3NCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIxMDQzMzBhMi04ZDE2LWVlMTEtYTliYi0wMDIyNDgzMmViNzMiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=au0fWSTTbjQ_XOhiEn6AZ3l_pGj605sssk1OQ0NU46E=)**

clean_body: | If you need any further proof that our 2024 race is going to be just as tough as it was in 2022, take a look at this: At the end of April, the National Republican Congressional Committee (NRCC) announced their top targets for 2024, and I’m on the list. They have wasted no time spreading misleading attacks about my record, funneling millions of dollars into blanketing mid-Michigan with dark money funded attack ads against me. Tomorrow is our first Federal Election Commission (FEC) quarterly filing deadline since new attacks were launched against us, and I need your help to fight back. My team needs to raise another $8,000 before tomorrow night to hit our FEC goal to prove the misinformation will never work. = If you saved your payment information with ActBlue Express, clicking a button below will cause your donation to process instantly. | | = | = | = | = | = | = I fight everyday in Congress to advocate for the people of mid-Michigan. I’m working to lower costs and to create good-paying jobs. I’m working to improve infrastructure, make prescription drugs and health care more affordable, and protect Social Security and Medicare. And, one year after the Supreme Court decision to overturn Roe v. Wade, I’m still fighting in Congress for federal protections for abortion and to protect your right to make your own health care decisions. While some of my colleagues seemingly are constantly distracted by petty politics and hoping for news airtime, I’m in Congress to lower the temperature of politics and to get results for Michiganders. That’s what Michiganders need: results, not extremist rhetoric and partisan games. = Thank you for standing with me, Dan Congressman Dan Kildee – a Flint native – is proud to represent mid-Michigan. As a Democratic party leader, Dan is fighting hard to ensure every American has access to quality health care, clean water and a good-paying job. The path to take back the Democratic majority in the House runs right through the Midwest, and Dan is dedicated to protecting and electing Democratic candidates. But we can’t do it without you! = | = | = Paid for by Friends of Dan Kildee Friends of Dan Kildee P.O. Box 248 Flint, MI 48501 United States **

subject: He did it! What now?
body:
How will this shakeout?
---
| | | | | | Joe Budd - The ONLY Budd for You!
---
|
---
| |
---
| | |
---
| Trump vs. DeSantis
---
| He did it. Governor DeSantis threw his hat into the ring for President. Now what? Let's get the suspense out of the way... I endorse Ron DeSantis for President in the 2024 republican primary! Yes, I founded Club 45. Yes, I was a very early supporter of Donald J. Trump and worked incredibly hard for his 2016 republican nomination, the general election, and his 2020 re-election. I voted for him four times and worked countless volunteer hours for his campaign and his trips as President to Mar-A-Lago. Serving as a driver in many, many motorcades, volunteering at the airport, driving VIP guests. It was a thrill of a lifetime with many stories to tell. I defended him against attacks from the left and the never Trumper crowd. Lost some friends in the process. Thank you President Trump for everything you've done but, I'm out. I want to win the White House in 2024. I don't think Trump can win a general election. Thank you for all the kind words you lavished on Governor DeSantis. Governor DeSantis earned them. DeSantis is MAGA and America First through and through and President Trump acknowledged that fact over and over again. I didn't like the title of this Real Clear Politics article I was interviewed for back in September, 2021 but I agree with it now. Link: [Trump Should Back DeSantis](https://r20.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001Vsy7DWxRqdk0660gfZJJEGQaBDnf-vIAgm1uHpd7lzXo-2MSgCoOOPLheH-vfuN58O6Q8jAnYB5AMb2lTxXc8doQtiLLOM8yivUHPPzc684eQ4veI0XTxzsh4rflPkyefy1ZyEQlkIFNjrb3NN0GNAFDm5UOCOXz50LmNl4iI2_bzVLj0bbhiQbsg0FJ1_PcypzAy68mlSzuHm94fdBsNS0nw71ZXo1xuRE9Y7gxjIUh4ySP3TOOO-IOH1WcHc6rjsRGiMp9hrZRG-m8Phu0qGgdmC73rk88fb4cHf564Hg=&c=ovZqj65FPa5W8LuUAqdIXz2Q0d65U022NgiyWqEzH_eGT0j-WtIbNA==&ch=P7Cm0JsEGHNWwtyE09KDXHtKhCckJIGUwj2ZVh0LiLQeUoJDp3_e6g==)
---
| | |
---
| A word of caution:
"Never Trumpers and Only Trumpers have one thing in common, they elect Democrats" \- Joe
---
| | |
---
| |
---
| Don't be a Never Trumper or an Only Trumper. If Trump wins the nomination, I will support him for President. I will support any of the Republican nominees over any Democrat period. I don't elect Democrats. I hope you don't either.

---
| | |

My wife Sherry was recently diagnosed with breast cancer. While it was caught early and treatable, it will be a hard road forward full of emotions, ups and downs, and difficult decisions. I will walk with her through every step of the process. Faith, Family and Freedom. In that order. I love you Sherry Budd!

name: Colin Allred
subject: Why Texas Is So Important
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Booker for Kentucky
body:
Peter: This race is bigger than defeating Ted Cruz. Our
Democratic Senate majority and the White House are on the line in 2024.

The future of our democracy and so many of our fundamental rights, from
voting to reproductive freedom, depend on Democrats winning.
Unfortunately, the 2024 Senate map strongly favors Republicans.

But here's the thing: Experts at CNN and FiveThirtyEight are calling Texas
our BEST pickup opportunity – and if we can flip this seat, Democrats are
virtually guaranteed to defend the Senate!

[ https://act.charlesbooker.org/go/18985?t=1001&akid=3355%2E346206%2ENIa8F1 ]Please, split a donation of $25 or more between my campaign and Charles
Booker before our midnight deadline to help Colin Allred beat Ted Cruz,
flip Texas blue and defend our Democratic Senate majority! →

Our chances have never looked better to flip Texas: This team raised more
in our first 24 hours than Ted Cruz raised in the first three months of
the year, causing Inside Elections to update their official Texas ranking
from "Solid Republican" to "Battleground." People are calling this the
political fight of Ted Cruz's life.

That’s why Mitch McConnell, GOP mega donors and shady special interests
are going to spend whatever it takes to save Ted Cruz and defeat Colin.

But we've got to keep up our momentum, friend, and that's where you come
in. We have an ambitious $150,000 daily fundraising goal because in a
battleground race, money could be the difference between winning and
losing. Right now, we're falling short, and we're counting on you to help
close the gap.

[ https://act.charlesbooker.org/go/18985?t=1002&akid=3355%2E346206%2ENIa8F1 ]Please, will you split a donation of $25 or more between our campaign
and Charles Booker to help us defeat Ted Cruz? Every dollar matters in our
fight to flip Texas blue and protect the Senate – and the future of our
democracy – from Cruz and his allies →

| Peter,

I know you’ve received a lot of messages from my campaign team recently about our FEC deadline and how vital our early campaign work is to winning another election. I wanted to reach out personally to put that sentiment in context.

We must defend against intense outside pressure and investment for competitive races like ours, even in a year without a Congressional election. National Republican groups want to flip VA-07 red badly, and are willing to pour millions into our district to do it.

Their investment leads to countless attack ads online, on TV, and on billboards. They’ll mobilize their field forces to campaign against me and the work I’ve done in Congress. And they’ll recruit prominent national figures – just like Ted Cruz last cycle – to visit Virginia to support my eventual opponent.

All this means we have a challenging road ahead, but one that I know will again lead to victory because of the community we have behind this campaign. _**So, why does early investment matter?**_

It allows us to scale up our campaign team early and build a strong foundation for success. We can purchase campaign materials like yard signs and literature to get the word out about my candidacy, and we can defend my track record and stand up to Republican attack ads.

Additionally, substantial FEC quarterly fundraising numbers can stave off Republican attacks in the first place. The stronger our campaign is, the less likely they are to pour money into a seat they can’t win.

This network is essential to our campaign, and I’m counting on your support in the 2024 cycle and beyond. This is West Virginia Governor Jim Justice. I’m writing today to let you know that after six highly successful years as governor of the Mountain State, **I launched my campaign to be the next United States senator for West Virginia**.

The stakes in this U.S. Senate race are high.**** Joe Manchin and I have known one another for a very long time, but I’m afraid I cannot stomach the idea of him serving in the Senate any longer. As much as I like Joe Manchin on a personal level, **as long as he represents West Virginia in DC, Chuck Schumer will continue to rule over the Senate with an iron fist.**

**I’m getting into this critical Senate race because we cannot allow Joe Manchin to play kingmaker in D.C. any longer.**
Joe Biden and Chuck Schumer’s agenda is too disastrous; we must take action TODAY. [** STAND WITH ME

| I could have kept quiet about this, but I owe it to the voters to tell them when a politician, who is trying to earn their trust, is also being untruthful to them. In fact, as someone who is running for political office, I feel it is my responsibility to tell you the truth and set things straight - something you should expect from a leader.
And I’m not suggesting you take my word for it (although you could because we’ve been friends for years and Bob hoodwinked me about this before). To save you the same trouble, I attached the proof below.
Let’s begin ...
My opponent has tried to legitimize his record by saying in his words, “he was just a yellow dog democrat” and only voted that way because that’s the way things always were in the South. He also claims he more recently voted Democrat so he could vote for local elected officials like sheriff in Panola County, where he just moved from a few months ago just so he could run for office in DeSoto County. What he’s not telling you is that the sheriff was not on the ballot in 2008, 2016 or 2020.
Those elections were for President of the United States.
Here’s the truth: Instead of voting for McCain in 2008, he voted for Barack Obama. Instead of voting for Donald J. Trump or Ted Cruz in 2016, he voted for the Democrat option. And on a cold day on March 10, 2020 my opponent, Bob Morris, stood in line to vote for the party that was still crushing small businesses and rallying to defund the police. The party that was stoking race riots and tearing down cultural statues. The party that’s cheering on as men compete and beat our little girls in sports. The party that wants to violate our second amendment and take away our God given rights to self defense. The party that wants to pack the Supreme Court so they can usurp our freedoms. The party that has us on the verge of WW3 because of their incompetence.
Those are the values he voted for.
But nothing could be worse than voting for Joe Biden, right? Think again! He’s even donated to their party. Don’t believe me? Ask him to explain why he donated to Matt Cartwright - a swing state anti-gun, liberal in Pennsylvania that co-sponsored the assault weapon ban of 2022 - the same congressman who received donations from George Soros. Again, all of this is documented by public records. And that’s not the only Democrat he’s donated to either.
Now, I realize his strongest supporters will embrace his candidacy regardless of detailed facts and documentation; some will even attack me. But this post is not intended to persuade them, rather, to forewarn those who don’t follow politics on a regular basis, truly care about about our future, and want to keep liberal ideology out of DeSoto County.
There’s one thing for sure, we are being lied to enough by politicians in Washington and the Legacy Media. We don’t need a life-long, Democrat politician who is willing to mislead us to earn votes, too.

**Meet Matthew Barton**
---

Matthew Barton grew up in Petal, Mississippi in a blue-collar family. His mother was a director at Tupperware and his father owned the small, family business – Barton Fence Company – where Matthew worked growing up.
After attending public school, Matthew attended Pearl River Community College and Warner University, where he studied Business Administration. He holds a law degree from Ole Miss Law, where he graduated Cum Laude and received the interviewing and counseling award.
In 2011, Matthew married his high school sweetheart, Megan. After graduating from Ole Miss Law in 2015, they moved to DeSoto County where Matthew started a law firm and Megan continued working at the Desoto County Schools as a Certified Occupational Therapy Assistant.
During law school, Matthew served as an intern in the DeSoto County District Attorney’s Office where he presented cases to grand jury, tried cases to verdict, and performed all functions of a practicing attorney. He has served as a prosecutor for the City of Southaven and the City of Horn Lake and now serves as a special prosecutor for Southaven, Horn Lake, and DeSoto County Justice Courts – where he’s established a strict, tough on crime reputation.
As an attorney, Mathew has dealt with every type of criminal matter ranging from DUI to capital murder, in more than 37 courts across Mississippi.
Matthew is a member of the Federalist Society, a conservative legal association, an enhanced conceal carry permit holder, Krewe of Hernando member, NRA member, and donates his time serving as a pro bono attorney to Veterans every year.
Today, Matthew, his wife Megan, and their daughter Eleanor live in Hernando where Matthew owns his private law firm. Eleanor attends Pre-K at Hernando United Methodist Church and Megan is a stay at home mom after seven years with DeSoto County schools.

Folks,
Last week, Kevin McCarthy took up the resolution attacking me for holding Trump accountable.
After Trump threatened a primary challenge against any Republican who refused to vote for it, MAGA Republicans officially passed their resolution to censure me. Why? Because I upheld my oath of office and held Donald Trump accountable for his many abuses of power.

One of my proudest moments in Congress was last year when I voted for the Inflation Reduction Act — a landmark bill with critical provisions to lower the cost of prescription drugs. Because of what Democrats did, the price of insulin was capped at just $35 per month, and the government is now able to negotiate for lower prices on other drugs and crack down on drug companies that have price-gouged Americans for far too long.

**We successfully took on Big Pharma and delivered real change.** And because of how politics in Washington works, that means special interests are now working to undo progress and punish those who stood up to them.

[**I'm not about to let Big Pharma — or any special interest — buy this seat and silence the voices of my constituents. Will you stand with me before Friday's FEC deadline to help me gear up for a costly fight ahead? Every grassroots donation we get sends a powerful message about the enthusiasm behind this campaign.**](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/65619889/414034214/219622400?refcode=EM_FR_230629EOQ1_EOQ_JW_FULL_9_NG_N_L1&fn=&ln=&em=dpwillis67@gmail.com&add1=&ci=Cresco&st=PA&pc=18326&oc=&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzAvMS85MTA2OSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI3MWYyMDdhNC05MjE2LWVlMTEtYTliYi0wMDIyNDgzMmViNzMiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=cEST61mi5PgnwK3SGZZ-9noE1D48_Uys8B7vcTlu3qw=) [Donate](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/65619890/414034215/219622400?refcode=EM_FR_230629EOQ1_EOQ_JW_FULL_9_NG_N_B1&fn=&ln=&em=dpwillis67@gmail.com&add1=&ci=Cresco&st=PA&pc=18326&oc=&amount=10&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzAvMS85MTA2OSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI3MWYyMDdhNC05MjE2LWVlMTEtYTliYi0wMDIyNDgzMmViNzMiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=cEST61mi5PgnwK3SGZZ-9noE1D48_Uys8B7vcTlu3qw=) Big Pharma is working with one of the top lobbying firms in the country on an autopsy report about its failure to stop the Inflation Reduction Act. body:
[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/65620240/414035299/1272516037?refcode=em_XX_XXXX.XX.XX_XX_XX_header_logo&amount=25&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNTAvMS8xMDUwMDAiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiY2IxMzQ2N2EtOTMxNi1lZTExLWE5YmItMDAyMjQ4MzJlYjczIiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=ZlVKSQuMzRncCWgfnN8IJdpWV2hzzvGQo3uj0bqWgdQ=) Friends –

We all get so many political emails in our inboxes. They all end up sounding the same. But I have known Andrei for nearly a quarter of a century, and we’ve been married for over 17 years. There is nobody that knows him better. [**So I asked to send this personal email to you to tell you why I hope you’ll give Andrei your support.**](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/65620241/414035300/1693584905?refcode=em_fr_2023.06.29_b1_sc_all&amount=33&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNTAvMS8xMDUwMDAiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiY2IxMzQ2N2EtOTMxNi1lZTExLWE5YmItMDAyMjQ4MzJlYjczIiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=ZlVKSQuMzRncCWgfnN8IJdpWV2hzzvGQo3uj0bqWgdQ=)

You often hear about Andrei’s professional achievements. But it’s his values and who he is as a person that is why I believe he should be in Congress.

He’s the dad and husband who cooks dinner for us most nights, no matter what else is going on or how busy he is.

He is someone who would much rather stay at home to watch a movie with us than go to a fancy dinner.

And the only reason he would take on something like this campaign for Congress is that he believes our democracy and our planet are on the line, and he cares about our kids – and all of our kids – too much to just stand by.

[**Tomorrow is the most important campaign fundraising deadline of this entire race. Would you chip in now to help him out?**](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/65620242/414035301/1693584905?refcode=em_fr_2023.06.29_b1_sc_all&amount=33&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNTAvMS8xMDUwMDAiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiY2IxMzQ2N2EtOTMxNi1lZTExLWE5YmItMDAyMjQ4MzJlYjczIiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=ZlVKSQuMzRncCWgfnN8IJdpWV2hzzvGQo3uj0bqWgdQ=)

Our kids are 12 and 15, and so when he started thinking about running for Congress, we had a family discussion. We went through what it would be like – the time away from family during the campaign and if he won, the millions of dollars of attack ads that would be spent against him. We tried our best not to sugarcoat it.

Our kids asked why he wanted to run, and Andrei talked about the difference he thought he could make, about all the ways in which our country and community deserved to be better represented, and all the people whose lives he could help. And – without hesitating – our kids said: you would, and nobody could do it better than you.

If you've been contemplating making a donation but have been putting it off or waiting until the election draws closer, I understand. It's natural to hesitate and to think your support will matter more later on. However, I want to emphasize to you what I’ve learned: that your contribution will have the greatest impact if made before June 30.

[**Every dollar counts, and your contribution will be instrumental in Andrei’s journey. As Andrei’s wife, as a mother, and as a voter, I assure you that Andrei is the kind of person we want in our Congress. | | Peter,
---
| **I’m excited to announce that Former King County Councilwoman Kathy Lambert has endorsed my candidacy to serve Washingtonians in Congress!**

Lambert served on the King County Council from 2002 to 2022 and her leadership resulted in resources and training for law enforcement, programs to reduce recidivism, and initiatives that empowered small businesses to succeed.
---
| [ ](https://mcshanellc.us10.list-manage.com/track/click?u=ac7c5348d309f6a3d3cffd39b&id=2514ddb3fe&e=0e51d1e991)
---
| **Kathy shared the following statement:**

_“Carmen would bring many needed talents as she has a financial background and that knowledge will be so beneficial. She communicates well with all people and will be a voice for you.”_

_**I am deeply honored to have this endorsement from Kathy**_. Her years of dedicated service and leadership in King County have had a profound impact on her community. I deeply admire her commitment to law enforcement, reducing recidivism, and supporting small businesses.

I am thrilled to have her support as I seek to bring my financial background and ability to partner with Washington public servants as I work for the people in Congress.

Our national debt crisis requires the attention of an accountant mindset that is determined to balance the books without imposing unrealistic taxation remedies on a people who are already burdened by the heavy yoke of Big Government.

**Peter, no matter how determined I am to spearhead remedies that address our financial crisis, I won’t make it to Congress to serve as that problem solver without your support!**

Dear friend, one of the biggest moments of our year is coming up fast, and I knew I had to reach out to you early with a crucial update. Our planet is at a critical tipping point. This means our fight to protect vital ecosystems and the creatures that depend on them is more urgent than ever.
Friends of the Earth won’t take excuses from bad actors and the mega-polluting industries pushing our planet to the brink. We see clearly that **corporate pollution is a choice.** **Together, we WILL hold companies accountable for that choice. **
**Right now, innocent animals are facing extreme risk of extinction from human-driven habitat loss and the worsening climate crisis. Mega-manufacturing plants are covering our planet in single-use plastics just to rack up more profits. The amount of their plastics in our oceans could exceed the number of fish by 2050 unless we act. Meanwhile, mining, logging and drilling companies are aggressively attacking the Endangered Species Act – our strongest protection for vulnerable creatures and the vital habitats they call home. **
We know the consequences of their rampant greed will be devastating pollution and the destruction of lands and waterways essential to wildlife survival and to human health. **But it doesn’t have to be this way, and we don’t have to stand aside while our only Earth collapses under this terrible burden. **
**That’s why this opportunity is so important: A generous group of donors is matching every gift we receive up to our $150,000 End of Fiscal Year goal, but only until midnight FRIDAY. Because you've been such a committed supporter, we created a custom match link you can use to be the first to DOUBLE your impact at this crucial moment in our fight for the planet and its inhabitants. So please hurry and make your gift for our planet now! Here’s your personal link:**
| | [[EARLY MATCH ACCESS FOR dpwillis67@gmail.com]](https://us.engagingnetworks.app/page/email/click/10012/1851843?email=RepJ2ZGQKX6xm5Aey7FwClESkN1MQhKC&campid=UI6tX83ZqbKZkArzVWMSmA==)
---
This goal means so much to our organization and the planet. We chose you to be part of this select group for early match access because we know you understand how high the stakes are for our Earth and everything that lives on it. **When you make your early-bird membership donation now, you'll be ensuring that Friends of the Earth can continue to mobilize activists on the ground, keep pressure on our lawmakers to do the right thing and stop the corporation-driven pollution crisis from putting the future of our planet at risk. **
The situation is dire, but getting complacent or giving in to despair is simply not an option. That’s why we must seize this opportunity for our planet right now, friend. **Matches like this don’t come often, and the stakes for our only Earth have never been higher. **So we’re counting on committed environmentalists like you to set the pace for the rest of our community.
**We've got to make this goal really count. So please, your personalized match access link is right here – donate now to have every dollar doubled toward our crucial End of Fiscal Year goal:**
| | [[EARLY MATCH ACCESS FOR dpwillis67@gmail.com]](https://us.engagingnetworks.app/page/email/click/10012/1851843?email=RepJ2ZGQKX6xm5Aey7FwClESkN1MQhKC&campid=UI6tX83ZqbKZkArzVWMSmA==)

Erich Pica

## Do you agree that there is a double standard for members of the administrative state--that the ruling elite is not required to follow the same rules as other Americans?
[YES](https://links.conservativesgive.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=87ae7641dbaf4f58b086b9a3dad8a3d8&_e=rSWURIYyQZEpVU6hP3WjNNhZHMZ8eufbqn870SQ1_pHRr3HRrG9HRz-kqpvwkqTdOhTEXx3jH8UO7xYoItkDgg9FE6dsFnxgPpcFMpCKskkqYmq_r-FAWW4OpKfLLrcYzb8kxIMnb-GUOU6qPmoMpj89DEwzWMG04bqdP25dEIeuKe5Ec07OnLiAixeKLYiMsIp7cB1fH4LGyK6pPW9H_7F0viCwS29YwReHnRa4s1VqxnnphqdDbNWtkYiuN6vOcIka-lDo4oHgIVLnfTdyoduLy-9pFDVjkWSKHhXF0hM18s6bYeA1uag4tvW47oAgZ1Mf5rlIcAvaQ5tgqrgtp24D_L1ddywxMpHH8Bj3ZIWvzewcm8TuV8Lv4LtDhcEoaLGBjAYsEuquofaMreWITt2BA1EcFxnTgsKKia7hpNQ%3D) [NO](https://links.conservativesgive.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=87ae7641dbaf4f58b086b9a3dad8a3d8&_e=rSWURIYyQZEpVU6hP3WjNNhZHMZ8eufbqn870SQ1_pHRr3HRrG9HRz-kqpvwkqTdOhTEXx3jH8UO7xYoItkDgg9FE6dsFnxgPpcFMpCKskkqYmq_r-FAWW4OpKfLLrcYzb8kxIMnb-GUOU6qPmoMpj89DEwzWMG04bqdP25dEIeuKe5Ec07OnLiAixeKLYiMsIp7cB1fH4LGyK6pPW9H_7F0viCwS29YwReHnRa4s1VqxnnphqdDbNWtkYiuN6vOcIka-lDo4oHgIVLnfTdyoUSHEzXAHj9AvDvOkQqd9c6nEGADS4-kOw61c6fubBiFXzlpsFLPYyJIRv-_iiTj0u5HOGstNI2CvVqqocclum5P-ZywNQb80_RuYDew_zMmDY6j5ZqWLt01DmB7AsStVG4h29GNM_x4MCXcR25hv8I%3D) Responding will only take a few minutes. Your input as an informed patriot is needed right away...because **our country is facing a constitutional crisis**.

It's a crisis that involves a fundamental political question: **who rules whom?**

The Constitution established a limited government in which the **people** ruled through their elected officials. Under this form of government, America became the freest and most prosperous nation in history.

Today, however, our constitutional system is one that increasingly exists in name only. **The Constitution of "We the People" is being replaced by an elite, out-of-touch, and unaccountable administrative state that rules without the consent of American citizens.** This means we live in an era of growing bureaucratic despotism, manifested in an administrative state that bypasses the Constitution, rejects the separation of powers, and replaces the rule of law with regulations.

**But we can 't just TALK about the problem. We also have to TAKE ACTION--to DO SOMETHING about it, while there's still time to save our country. **

That is why I'm writing to you today.

Hillsdale College is committed to returning to the Constitution of "We the People"--before it's too late.

To do that, I need your input. What are your opinions on this topic--knowing that we can propose SOLUTIONS that will restore liberty?

**Please let me know your thoughts today by answering the National Referendum on the Administrative State using this secure link:**

**[https://lp.hillsdale.edu/administrative-state-survey/](https://links.conservativesgive.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=87ae7641dbaf4f58b086b9a3dad8a3d8&_e=rSWURIYyQZEpVU6hP3WjNNhZHMZ8eufbqn870SQ1_pHRr3HRrG9HRz-kqpvwkqTdOhTEXx3jH8UO7xYoItkDgg9FE6dsFnxgPpcFMpCKskkqYmq_r-FAWW4OpKfLLrcYzb8kxIMnb-GUOU6qPmoMpj89DEwzWMG04bqdP25dEIeuKe5Ec07OnLiAixeKLYiMsIp7cB1fH4LGyK6pPW9H_7F0viCwS29YwReHnRa4s1VqxnnphqdDbNWtkYiuN6vOcIka-lDo4oHgIVLnfTdyoYEa5GlOQWj_nhM3bDNfosVWWCwRI3mmAMiqFprMhDry-dGHRlTalcy8TuIs2AC9h9tHakdFsQf29mhGeLtE_JNYeBmDTpU9h-hhOAWjm9TC-H89qLY3pLal8BOg5Rg66Tihf3dAozJejMbApKCgOLE%3D)**

Thank you for being on the side of the Constitution and liberty!

Warm regards,

Larry P. Arnn

name: Ben Staton, Courier Newsroom
subject: Tomorrow’s deadline is a big one
body:
We’re counting on you to help us raise the $11,000 remaining toward our end-of-quarter goal.
# [](https://act.couriernewsroom.com/go/83?t=1&akid=1174%2E120351%2EICwmfh)
Hi Peter, Ben here.
I’m the new Finance Director for Courier Newsroom, which means I’m responsible for pulling together the resources we need to support all 8 of our newsrooms. And I couldn’t be more excited to join Courier’s fight against misinformation in battleground states across the country!
**Right now, we’re still running about $11,000 short of our end-of-quarter goal, so we need help if we’re going to get there by tomorrow night’s deadline.**
[**If you’ll give me just another minute of your time, I’ll explain what reaching this goal will mean for our newsrooms — but first, can you pitch in $5 to close this gap?**](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/em-courier-20230629?refcode=em20230629&refcode2=1174_120351_ICwmfh&akid=1174%2E120351%2EICwmfh)
**[Chip in $5 »](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/em-courier-20230629?refcode=em20230629&refcode2=1174_120351_ICwmfh&akid=1174%2E120351%2EICwmfh)**
Courier Newsroom operates in ‘news deserts’ that lack other reliable sources of fact-based reporting on local issues. Our journalists pick up the national media’s slack and call out misinformation for what it is – **and** **we don’t hide**** _any_****of our content behind paywalls.**
Instead, we count on the generous support of grassroots donors like you to help power our work. So here’s what closing this $11,000 gap means:
* It means **expanding** the reach of our stories, all while keeping them **free** _._
* It means **hiring more journalists** to chase important leads.
* And it means opening **_more_****newsrooms in**** _more_****states**.

If that isn’t enough to convince you, I’ll also let you in on a secret I’ve learned as Finance Director: Less than 1% of the people who receive this email will actually make a contribution. So if you think our goal will be met by someone else, think again!
**We really are counting on**** __you__** **to help us raise the $11,000 remaining to hit our end-of-quarter goal so we can keep providing reliable local journalism to communities that need it.**
[**So please, pitch in $5 or any amount you can now to help us reach this goal and keep up this essential work.**](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/em-courier-20230629?refcode=em20230629&refcode2=1174_120351_ICwmfh&akid=1174%2E120351%2EICwmfh)
**[Chip in $5 »](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/em-courier-20230629?refcode=em20230629&refcode2=1174_120351_ICwmfh&akid=1174%2E120351%2EICwmfh)**
Thank you,
Ben Staton
_Finance Director_
_Courier Newsroom_

# [](https://act.tammybaldwin.com/go/67?t=1&akid=477%2E35263%2E2YMyKC)
Hi Peter, Minnesota Senator Tina Smith here. Let’s be honest: it shouldn’t be that hard to tell me apart from my good friend Tammy Baldwin. _But it happens more often than you might think!_ [](https://act.tammybaldwin.com/go/2155?c0=tbe-em-jun23.CtqEq3&refcode=AU_STB_FR_GEN_GEN_AC_20230629_AM1_V1_S1&t=4&akid=477%2E35263%2E2YMyKC) More than once, reporters or staffers have mixed us up in the halls of the Senate. Just recently, Peter, I was followed around by someone asking me “gotcha” questions — someone we call a “tracker.” That’s right: GOP campaigns or national Republican organizations will often hire someone to trail a candidate around as they talk to voters. They try to take misleading videos of us to attack our campaigns. Well, this “tracker” was asking me questions that made it clear he was mixing up me and fellow Midwesterner, Tammy. Honestly, I thought the whole thing was pretty funny. And while I knew better than to answer his ridiculous questions with a camera in my face, here’s what I’ll say about Tammy’s record: She has fought tirelessly for affordable healthcare, LGBTQ+ rights, veterans, working families, and so much more. She is deeply committed to making life better for every Wisconsinite — and I’m proud to serve alongside her in the Senate. But Tammy is in for a tough reelection campaign — if Republican operatives already have someone trailing her (or me, in this case), that means they’re going to throw so many misleading ads her way in no time. **Experts have named Tammy as one of 2024’s most vulnerable Senators, so I’m reaching out to ask:** **[Can you chip in to Tammy’s campaign so she can keep up the progress for Wisconsin? **GET TO KNOW VIVEK:** Vivek is an American entrepreneur, political and cultural thought leader, and New York Times bestselling author of **_Woke, Inc.: Inside Corporate America's Social Justice Scam_** , along with his second book, **_Nation of Victims: Identity Politics, the Death of Merit, and the Path Back to Excellence_**.

Vivek is a first-generation American. | A native Floridian with blue-collar roots, Ron was raised in Dunedin by his mother, a nurse, and father, who installed cable boxes. He attended Dunedin High School and worked his way through Yale University, where he was the captain of the varsity baseball team. He also graduated with honors from Harvard Law School, where he earned a commission in the U.S. Navy as a JAG officer.

During his active-duty service, Ron deployed to Iraq in support of the SEAL mission in Fallujah, Ramadi and the rest of Al Anbar province. His military decorations include the Bronze Star Medal for Meritorious Service and the Iraq Campaign Medal.
---
Ron also served as a prosecutor in Florida, where he put child predators behind bars. He was elected to Congress in 2012 on a platform of government accountability, advocating for term limits and a balanced budget amendment.

In Congress, DeSantis spearheaded the fight to expose the weaponization of the IRS against conservatives. He also fought to hold accountable the rogue federal agencies involved in manufacturing the "Russia collusion" conspiracy theory. As a veteran, DeSantis was a champion for those who have served our country, pushing for reforms to the VA to better serve veterans and expand support for mental health.

In 2018, Ron DeSantis was elected the 46th Governor of Florida. As governor, he has fought for what's right and taken the arrows for the people he represents. During the darkest days of 2020, when the corrupt establishment, bureaucracy, and corporate media united to force lockdowns and mandates on Americans, DeSantis stood up for freedom - even when it wasn't popular.

Grounded in his unshakeable belief in America's founding principles, Governor DeSantis has enacted a bold agenda to transform Florida into a blueprint for the Nation's revival. Governor DeSantis has delivered win after win on conservative priorities:
* Saving livelihoods from job-killing lockdowns and vaccine mandates,

* Protecting citizens from the harmful impacts of Biden's border crisis by enacting E-Verify and other bold policies against illegal immigration, such as banning sanctuary cities,

* Defending parental rights and eliminating CRT,

* Defunding DEI bureaucracy in higher ed and holding tenured professors accountable,

* Waging war on woke power-grabs like ESG and central bank digital currency,

* Enacting the strongest medical freedom laws in the nation,

* Turning Florida into a model for election integrity,

* Protecting the unborn,

* Standing up for the 2nd Amendment by making Florida a constitutional carry state,

* Expanding education freedom,

* Prohibiting land purchases by the CCP and related individuals and entities,

* Lowering prescription drug costs,

* Holding woke corporations and school unions accountable,

* Creating a universal school choice program,

* Delivering record-breaking tax relief,

* Helping families achieve the American dream of homeownership,

* Supporting law enforcement and our veterans,

* Enacting tougher penalties for drug dealers and sex offenders,

* Appointing seven conservative justices to the Florida Supreme Court,

* ...and so much more.

After leading Florida with common sense and conviction throughout his first term, DeSantis delivered a record-setting victory of nearly 20 points in 2022. He earned his second term by the largest raw vote margin in state history, winning by more than 1.5 million votes.

But history didn't stop there:

Governor DeSantis flipped Miami-Dade County red, winning the majority-Hispanic urban county by double digits. Conventional wisdom assumed this was impossible for a Republican - as recently as 2016, Hillary Clinton won Miami-Dade County by nearly 30 points.

# Jeremy Hitchcock, Founder of Dyn and current Executive Chairman of Minim
---
In this episode, Dr. Mansharamani speaks with Jeremy Hitchcock, a New Hampshire entrepreneur who has built several very successful businesses. Jeremy shares his insights from building Dyn into a leading cloud computing company (before anyone knew what cloud computing was!), his adventures as a private pilot, and even some of his lessons learned as a venture capitalist. Jeremy also reminds us to focus on how much we all have in common, rather than how little we differ.
Tune in via the links below!

---
---
PRIOR EPISODES ALL AVAILABLE ON DEMAND!
For those who missed the prior episodes of NAVIGATING UNCERTAINTY, have no fear! They're all available on demand via the links below. As you sit in traffic during your weekend trips, tune in and use the opportunity to learn about some fascinating people as well as some of the most important topics of our times!
You'll find my conversations with Phil Taub, Partner at NixonPeabody and Co-Founder of SWIM WITH A MISSION, Morgan Ortagus, Former Spokesperson for the State Department, David Jordan, Founder of Seven Hills Foundation, John Avlon, Senior Political Analyst at CNN, Derek Leathers, Chairman & CEO of Werner Enterprises, Rudy Glocker, Founder of Burgeon Outdoor, former US Senator Kelly Ayotte, NCUA Vice Chair Kyle Hauptman, Miami Mayor Francis Suarez, NH Governor Chris Sununu, NH Education Czar Frank Edelblut, Commissioner of Business and Economic Affairs Taylor Caswell, GOP Presidential Candidate Vivek Ramaswamy, former Commander of NORAD and Retired Four Star General Lori Robinson, and former Chair of House Permanent Select Committee on Intelligence Mike Rogers.

name: Cori Bush via Justice Democrats
subject: winning the bold changes our communities deserve:
body:
Justice Democrats recruited me in 2017 and endorsed me again in 2020, providing necessary infrastructure and support to help us overcome the odds.
#
Peter,
I’ve lived the struggles that everyday Americans face. I’ve been a single parent living paycheck to paycheck. I know what it’s like to be unhoused living in my car with my two babies. I know what it’s like to be evicted. I know what it’s like to forgo seeking care because I didn’t have health insurance.
**My lived experiences drive my fierce urgency in Congress for the transformational change that our communities deserve.** The people are with us, but too many in power are satisfied with the status quo.
That’s why I’m grateful for Justice Democrats, which helped our campaign make history when we overcame an out-of-touch and entrenched political dynasty. I was the first candidate endorsed back in 2017, and since then Justice Democrats has provided necessary campaign infrastructure and support to help several of us overcome the odds.
[**Will you split a donation between my campaign and Justice Democrats today, so I can return to Congress and together, we can keep electing more unapologetic progressives to serve alongside me in our nation’s capital?**](https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/135363?refcode=em20230629-29656&amounts=10%2C27%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1&akid=29656%2E1203867%2E8ttiuM)
**[Contribute $3](https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/135363?refcode=em20230629-29656&t=20&akid=29656%2E1203867%2E8ttiuM)**
While protesting in the streets for over a year in the Ferguson Uprising, I had the opportunity to meet people from all walks of life in my community. **Until then, I had been primarily focused on survival.** But by coming together in solidarity, we got to know one another’s pain and we got to imagine what a future of collective liberation could look like.
Across the country, a huge people-powered movement is expanding what’s possible in the Democratic Party and our federal government. We have a vision of America that works for all of us, that treats every person with respect, and that recognizes housing and health care as a human right.
Too many of us have been let down by our elected officials, but there are bold progressive leaders everywhere who can be incredible public servants if given the opportunities to run for office and win.
[**Will you join me and Justice Democrats by splitting a contribution today so we can keep transforming politics and winning the bold changes our communities deserve?**](https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/135363?refcode=em20230629-29656&amounts=10%2C27%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=21&akid=29656%2E1203867%2E8ttiuM)
**[Split a Contribution](https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/135363?refcode=em20230629-29656&t=22&akid=29656%2E1203867%2E8ttiuM)**
Thank you so much.
With love,
Rep. Cori Bush
Do not worry if you cannot afford to make a contribution — we understand that this is a difficult time. If you’re struggling, you can find a food bank [here.](https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/28883?t=23&akid=29656%2E1203867%2E8ttiuM) We appreciate everything you do to keep our movement strong. Please stay informed and follow the most up-to-date recommendations from the [Centers for Disease Control](https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/24438?t=24&akid=29656%2E1203867%2E8ttiuM) and your state public health department.

name: Defend the Constitution
subject: Who rules whom?
body:
The Constitution established a limited government in which the people ruled through their elected officials.

| | |
---
| | This sponsored message from Defend the Constitution is on behalf of Hillsdale College [](https://links.defend-the-constitution.org/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=2f664b9f350e4494921c82df7a50c0ca&_e=KorbxPQ9-jnMBLOKt-wF5VYJm4QCQK-ZTo8SE6mIy3T3erTOhEaJzHw2s-GnbJUzMBTggoM5vZCyy8MVJGROEjzcGAzw78Z7O4wERn226DY2rE20Zy85jXxKStZN02kfE5Wo7mQX3Ez_crUMECf6dTwsULjvzUMatkwkG2UBWvMFQQwk9woP5iKkBV7sxRHYRTf0kqIxRDRkkIlgNU1kfHSoqkPsK1elHfWeHGY7LxbBng_gByvpxnaE-yAtF2n4Yug9w4LKT3Vrn8uVTN4pXr1f98MtMN8b-3J88gSblp3dyN5cxfRijZwSM4YOyC217xc34uergNpy9-8-vMxEnRuQXln0rb322afGcr_abUFwZHzArNljRJDNQH3-52nTvLi-g1uF8ZiMRQ7EwFhs4q0J2nibKTLlu2h7r7ksdcI%3D)
---
| | | Dear Fellow American, Hillsdale College has selected you to participate in its [**National Referendum on the Administrative State**](https://links.defend-the-constitution.org/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=2f664b9f350e4494921c82df7a50c0ca&_e=KorbxPQ9-jnMBLOKt-wF5VYJm4QCQK-ZTo8SE6mIy3T3erTOhEaJzHw2s-GnbJUzMBTggoM5vZCyy8MVJGROEjzcGAzw78Z7O4wERn226DY2rE20Zy85jXxKStZN02kfE5Wo7mQX3Ez_crUMECf6dTwsULjvzUMatkwkG2UBWvMFQQwk9woP5iKkBV7sxRHYRTf0kqIxRDRkkIlgNU1kfHSoqkPsK1elHfWeHGY7LxbBng_gByvpxnaE-yAtF2n4Yug9w4LKT3Vrn8uVTN4pXhyMqhugL3MhItyF2qkGWo9BXRGaxG4_D7YvZyhzin7BjRR5eNI5KYO5UXbBRiqHJ2XOjaVlZKO-doIurFs4vT9s-6VAHj2p5fdu3WmviVZeoVZDYkNvykVG4OF2oeKa9kPH-xU2IOFiTiXLtaRMTOA%3D).
## Do you agree that there is a double standard for members of the administrative state--that the ruling elite is not required to follow the same rules as other Americans?
[YES](https://links.defend-the-constitution.org/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=2f664b9f350e4494921c82df7a50c0ca&_e=KorbxPQ9-jnMBLOKt-wF5VYJm4QCQK-ZTo8SE6mIy3T3erTOhEaJzHw2s-GnbJUzMBTggoM5vZCyy8MVJGROEjzcGAzw78Z7O4wERn226DY2rE20Zy85jXxKStZN02kfE5Wo7mQX3Ez_crUMECf6dTwsULjvzUMatkwkG2UBWvMFQQwk9woP5iKkBV7sxRHYRTf0kqIxRDRkkIlgNU1kfHSoqkPsK1elHfWeHGY7LxbBng_gByvpxnaE-yAtF2n4Yug9w4LKT3Vrn8uVTN4pXs4RF4ipbciH59_lKBOB0zNYJbLOkrsa1N0cjqeqKVap_yaCTgNdbl3K-bqOfT8zhmEoNM8_RCDnDJIaLTOYIzYwtIwuyf9tnNiRzv-XBsQPKzHyOFPVhdBCe_SFU5lagsRLo-T2V0xMaIcXxCvjW6I%3D) [NO](https://links.defend-the-constitution.org/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=2f664b9f350e4494921c82df7a50c0ca&_e=KorbxPQ9-jnMBLOKt-wF5VYJm4QCQK-ZTo8SE6mIy3T3erTOhEaJzHw2s-GnbJUzMBTggoM5vZCyy8MVJGROEjzcGAzw78Z7O4wERn226DY2rE20Zy85jXxKStZN02kfE5Wo7mQX3Ez_crUMECf6dTwsULjvzUMatkwkG2UBWvMFQQwk9woP5iKkBV7sxRHYRTf0kqIxRDRkkIlgNU1kfHSoqkPsK1elHfWeHGY7LxbBng_gByvpxnaE-yAtF2n4Yug9w4LKT3Vrn8uVTN4pXhuKhVjJQV4PmLezo_P1_-VC0E4Lkb3jnd4wwhpNQYYTuVNd8z3h0VoYvbXit7HscEersWosHtUEmYLgf4ajrdE3QhKoxq_2C500ZvTJD3cfL_J3qPune8RZY07MyZJQ3T0Yksk2grUqVcejv0NTQJ4%3D) Responding will only take a few minutes. Your input as an informed patriot is needed right away...because **our country is facing a constitutional crisis**.

It's a crisis that involves a fundamental political question: **who rules whom?**

The Constitution established a limited government in which the **people** ruled through their elected officials. Under this form of government, America became the freest and most prosperous nation in history.

Today, however, our constitutional system is one that increasingly exists in name only. **The Constitution of "We the People" is being replaced by an elite, out-of-touch, and unaccountable administrative state that rules without the consent of American citizens.** This means we live in an era of growing bureaucratic despotism, manifested in an administrative state that bypasses the Constitution, rejects the separation of powers, and replaces the rule of law with regulations.

**But we can 't just TALK about the problem. We also have to TAKE ACTION--to DO SOMETHING about it, while there's still time to save our country. **

That is why I'm writing to you today.

Hillsdale College is committed to returning to the Constitution of "We the People"--before it's too late.

To do that, I need your input. What are your opinions on this topic--knowing that we can propose SOLUTIONS that will restore liberty?

**Please let me know your thoughts today by answering the National Referendum on the Administrative State using this secure link:**

**[https://lp.hillsdale.edu/administrative-state-survey/](https://links.defend-the-constitution.org/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=2f664b9f350e4494921c82df7a50c0ca&_e=KorbxPQ9-jnMBLOKt-wF5VYJm4QCQK-ZTo8SE6mIy3T3erTOhEaJzHw2s-GnbJUzMBTggoM5vZCyy8MVJGROEjzcGAzw78Z7O4wERn226DY2rE20Zy85jXxKStZN02kfE5Wo7mQX3Ez_crUMECf6dTwsULjvzUMatkwkG2UBWvMFQQwk9woP5iKkBV7sxRHYRTf0kqIxRDRkkIlgNU1kfHSoqkPsK1elHfWeHGY7LxbBng_gByvpxnaE-yAtF2n4Yug9w4LKT3Vrn8uVTN4pXo9rgMxwl4k2tRb5_6SDNLgtRtlnSKOKsaWxTmh36xiNDpWQ01PW_uzAFXaxqtTJEU-26iTz7CotPfcaUdTxDehWOtXEfB3A86cgd9DIMmifZ7fKKeyxkmB6DUl2JQvIABLi7Ac9a1sQX0KVVvRKJZI%3D)**

Thank you for being on the side of the Constitution and liberty!

Warm regards,

Larry P. Arnn
President, Hillsdale College

name: Dr. Ben Carson
subject: What are your thoughts?
body:
There is a very concerning trend occurring in our country that has me worried

|
---
| | | [](https://e.americandefensenews.com/rd/9z2zud528dl7lom4umapv85ee7hndjrvlk7anfpnmjg_rp22sh2s8i66o70s1jm4ob4cth2bs)
---
| Fellow American,

There is a very concerning trend occurring in our country that has me worried for Americans who hold to biblical & faith-based values. [](https://e.americandefensenews.com/rd/9z2zbgu0ebm8uvmf0cqfg3c041snmqscmat85lr25fo_rp22sh2s8i66o70s1jm4ob4cth2bs) After the _Respect for Marriage Act_ was passed by a bi-partisan effort and signed into law, I am fearful that legal persecution will only intensify against Americans holding to faith-based values and who wish to conduct their lives according to their faith.

[**Are you concerned that America is abandoning a basic tenet of our founding -_Religious Liberty?_**](https://e.americandefensenews.com/rd/9z2zl9lts16b2odpg3rio72pvqe4q2bdn0t2ljdbero_rp22sh2s8i66o70s1jm4ob4cth2bs)

In addition to the passing of the _Respect for Marriage Act_ , numerous examples over the past decade have concerned me: KENNEDY v. BREMERTON SCHOOL DISTRICT, MASTERPIECE CAKESHOP v. COLORADO CIVIL RIGHTS COMMISSION, and 303 CREATIVE v. ELENIS are just a few examples of legal persecution against Americans holding to faith-based values who wish to conduct their lives according to their faith.

Furthermore, an amendment to the _Respect for Marriage Act_ , brought forth by Senator Mike Lee, prohibiting the Federal Government from retaliating against schools, businesses, and organizations because of their religious beliefs about same-sex marriage failed.

**This has the potential to only intensify legal persecution against individuals, businesses, churches, and nonprofits holding to faith-based values. **

The American Cornerstone Institute is a non-profit that I founded to preserve and promote the cornerstones that laid the foundation for the greatest nation the world has ever seen: Faith, Liberty, Community, and Life.

Whether it is a football coach losing his job for praying at midfield after a game, or a baker being sued for not wanting to bake a cake that violates his religious values, **are you concerned as I am with the increase in legal persecution against Americans who wish to conduct their lives according to their faith?**

Please share your thoughts in this quick 2-minute survey concerning religious liberty in America.

**[https://offers.americancornerstone.org/religious-liberty-survey/](https://e.americandefensenews.com/rd/9z2zfibcfhoh9p5tecusjkshrgvkt5fneur9hbva1t8_rp22sh2s8i66o70s1jm4ob4cth2bs)**

Thank you for your consideration.

Regards,

Dr. Ben Carson
Founder & Chairman American Cornerstone Institute

body:
Help us finish June with strength!

http://wsrp.org
Ballots Are Out, Vote By November 2nd!

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=WeGlgXqOx-Y

With ballots out, now is the perfect time to get out there and volunteer on a conservative campaign. Every door you knock on in these local races matter a lot and the results of this election year will be used as a bellwether for the 2022 midterms.

We are also hosting another WSRP Statewide Day Of Action on Saturday, October 30th! Bring a friend or neighbor to volunteer for a few hours to help local conservatives win in November! Sign up here to join our Statewide Day Of Action! (https://form.jotform.com/212737084845058)
State Sen. Gildon On Vaccine Mandates
https://soundcloud.com/user-450836972/wagop-report-state-sen-chris-gildon-on-vaccine-mandates-and-democrat-anti-policing-laws
State Senator Chris Gildon (R - Puyallup) joins the podcast this week to discuss vaccine mandates, anti-policing laws, the Long-Term Care Tax, and how he got his start in politics. WAGOP is now on Apple Podcasts and Spotify, follow us and never miss an episode! Listen here. (https://soundcloud.com/user-450836972/wagop-report-state-sen-chris-gildon-on-vaccine-mandates-and-democrat-anti-policing-laws)
Republican Leaders Fight Inslee's Mandate
Thanks to our Republican leaders in the State House and Senate for fighting back and offering a strong rebuke of Inslee's harmful vaccine mandate. Below is an excerpt of their most recent statement to the press:

“We are already experiencing higher prices and empty shelves partially as a result of COVID's shutdowns and workforce shortages. Today's deadline, with its unnecessarily hardline consequences, will only make that worse when hundreds, if not thousands, lose their jobs and are denied unemployment benefits. It also threatens public safety by reducing our police forces at a time when crime is already rising. People feel unsafe. They are afraid of what criminals will do when there are even fewer law enforcement officers to respond. And they are worried about people's chances of survival if there aren't enough first responders to help in an emergency. The governor underestimates the potential impact of his actions.

“Coercion, intimidation, threats and public shaming are not tactics a leader should be using against the people. The governor's obvious disdain for those who are choosing to lose their jobs rather than compromise their right to make their own medical decisions is unhelpful. He is dividing the public – segregating us and turning people against each other. Yesterday, even unvaccinated health-care workers were heroes. Today, they become villains in the governor's narrative."

Read the full statement. (https://jtwilcox.houserepublicans.wa.gov/2021/10/18/republican-leaders-todays-vaccine-deadline-threatens-critical-services-public-safety/?fbclid=IwAR3WxI9H29hbbmfbZhdkDS9QjqdVd2TIRCdjNjUkUlLdeThtbUjK_WBWJuw)
Smiley Campaign Shows Grassroots Support In Latest Fundraising Quarter
Tiffany Smiley is fighting hard to retire Patty Murray and her latest fundraising numbers show not only has Tiffany raised more than $1.6 million but she also has unequivocal grassroots support, with over 10,000 donors from Washington State. Flipping a U.S. Senate seat is hard work but Tiffany has shown in the only 5 months since starting her campaign, that she is a force to be reckoned with. Learn more about how Tiffany stands on the issues here (https://www.smileyforwashington.com/issues) .

_Democrat Eric Swalwell represents California's 14th Congressional District. _
[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/65626944/414060814/-662322978?refcode=headerfooter-header&amount=25&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNDMvMS85MDcyNyIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI1N2Q4YTIxMy05ZjE2LWVlMTEtYTliYi0wMDIyNDgzMmViNzMiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=POm549uDyIRONhA-tAqZixCEoeyTysabX8IIw_pzd20=)
Friend, After the polls closed in my 2022 campaign against Ken Calvert, we were feeling pretty excited about our chances. The first few batches of votes released by the registrar showed us with a promising lead, and while the race hadn’t been called, things were good enough to get an invitation to attend new member orientation in Washington. [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/65626945/414060815/1500652250?refcode=E3169-20230629-RollinsSplit-Image-Surrogate&amount=25&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNDMvMS85MDcyNyIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI1N2Q4YTIxMy05ZjE2LWVlMTEtYTliYi0wMDIyNDgzMmViNzMiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=POm549uDyIRONhA-tAqZixCEoeyTysabX8IIw_pzd20=) _Day one of new member orientation last Fall. Credit: POLITICO._ It was awe-inspiring being inside the Capitol as a prospective member and learning about the job I’d spent a year running for and hoped to have. I also enjoyed getting to know some (we had hoped) soon-to-be colleagues. **Then, literally as I was standing on the House floor, I got the alert on my phone; a new batch of votes finally put Ken Calvert’s vote share out of reach. The Associated Press called the race, and I officially lost.** So my partner Paolo and I did what a lot of couples might do: We went to the hotel bar. As we were sitting there, news broke on TV that Donald Trump had just announced his campaign for president. And I knew in that moment that our fight wasn’t over yet — that our democracy remains fragile, and it’s on each of us to do what’s in our power to better our communities and our country. Friend, running for Congress a second time was not a decision I came to lightly, but I'm back in it because I know exactly what is at stake. It’s not the time to give up, and I’ve been so humbled that so many across Riverside County who supported our campaign in 2022 haven’t given up either. **We came closer than anyone expected in 2022 to flipping this seat, and I wouldn’t be in this if I wasn’t confident we could win. But I can’t do this alone:** [**The end of this month marks our first public FEC fundraising deadline of my campaign. I’m counting on you to be a part of this effort, friend. The first few batches of votes released by the registrar showed us with a promising lead, and while the race hadn’t been called, things were good enough to get an invitation to attend new member orientation in Washington. = Day one of new member orientation last Fall. I also enjoyed getting to know some (we had hoped) soon-to-be colleagues. Then, literally as I was standing on the House floor, I got the alert on my phone; a new batch of votes finally put Ken Calvert’s vote share out of reach. The Associated Press called the race, and I officially lost. So my partner Paolo and I did what a lot of couples might do: We went to the hotel bar. As we were sitting there, news broke on TV that Donald Trump had just announced his campaign for president. And I knew in that moment that our fight wasn’t over yet — that our democracy remains fragile, and it’s on each of us to do what’s in our power to better our communities and our country. Friend,
When I walk the halls of the United States Senate, I often ponder the work you and I are doing to leave our country better off for our children and grandchildren.
As Americans, we may disagree about how to address certain problems, but the problems themselves are matters of fact. Inequality is growing. Social mobility is at a standstill. Proper health care is beyond the reach of tens of millions. So is a good education and life lived in safety.
The ultimate goal of our work, friend, is creating a just society and if we are to truly accomplish that, I believe every American must have access to four essential freedoms.
Freedom to rise : Our policies need to value workers and working families — and they need to enable workers to organize on their own behalf.
https://secure.actblue.com/donate/embutton?refcode=X_062923_EOQ_D_act [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/embutton?refcode=X_062923_EOQ_D_act]
Freedom to learn: Without education — education that lasts a lifetime, education that extends to the way we advance our most cherished ideals — mobility and justice are out of reach.
https://secure.actblue.com/donate/embutton?refcode=X_062923_EOQ_D_act [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/embutton?refcode=X_062923_EOQ_D_act]
Freedom from violence: Violence affects our everyday lives — gun violence; our broken criminal justice system; addiction in communities everywhere; and the quieter violence that flourishes in social media.
https://secure.actblue.com/donate/embutton?refcode=X_062923_EOQ_D_act [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/embutton?refcode=X_062923_EOQ_D_act]
Freedom to govern ourselves: We need to confront voter suppression, gerrymandering, the influx of dark money into policies, and partisanship in Congress.

clean_body: [] Friend, When I walk the halls of the United States Senate, I often ponder the work you and I are doing to leave our country better off for our children and grandchildren. As Americans, we may disagree about how to address certain problems, but the problems themselves are matters of fact. Inequality is growing. Social mobility is at a standstill. Proper health care is beyond the reach of tens of millions. So is a good education and life lived in safety. The ultimate goal of our work, friend, is creating a just society and if we are to truly accomplish that, I believe every American must have access to four essential freedoms. Freedom to rise : Our policies need to value workers and working families — and they need to enable workers to organize on their own behalf. [] Freedom to learn: Without education — education that lasts a lifetime, education that extends to the way we advance our most cherished ideals — mobility and justice are out of reach. [] Freedom from violence: Violence affects our everyday lives — gun violence; our broken criminal justice system; addiction in communities everywhere; and the quieter violence that flourishes in social media. [] Freedom to govern ourselves: We need to confront voter suppression, gerrymandering, the influx of dark money into policies, and partisanship in Congress. [] Our big quarterly fundraising deadline is tomorrow. As we continue working to restore reproductive rights nationwide, curb the effects of climate change, and create a just society for our children and our grandchildren, I hope you’ll recommit to this fight and chip in what you can before tomorrow. # KLAYMAN: RINO COP OUT! BIDEN MUST BE IMPEACHED!

**CNN** House Republicans are preparing to let the push for potential impeachment proceedings dominate their agenda over the next few months, as Speaker Kevin McCarthy faces growing pressure from an increasingly restive right flank eager to take aim at President Joe Biden and his Cabinet.
The increased focus on impeachment — with Biden’s [attorney general](https://freedomwatchusa.us18.list-manage.com/track/click?u=72bc9b8de1fa17e6901eb23e7&id=6bf61ec368&e=8edd2b8f7d) and homeland security secretary the highest on the GOP’s list — underscores how Republicans are quickly shifting their focus to red-meat issues that could fire up their base, even as some in their conference are nervous about voter backlash over the more aggressive approach.
Between July and September, Republicans are slated to hear high-profile testimony from a trio of Biden Cabinet officials who have been top impeachment targets on the right: Homeland Security Secretary Alejandro Mayorkas, [FBI Director Christopher Wray,](https://freedomwatchusa.us18.list-manage.com/track/click?u=72bc9b8de1fa17e6901eb23e7&id=c2a2b1608d&e=8edd2b8f7d) and [Attorney General Merrick Garland.](https://freedomwatchusa.us18.list-manage.com/track/click?u=72bc9b8de1fa17e6901eb23e7&id=9909f0d695&e=8edd2b8f7d)
There’s also strong interest in hauling in David Weiss, the Trump-appointed US attorney who oversaw the criminal investigation into the president’s son, Hunter Biden, in an attempt to put the focus on Garland.

body:
[](https://click.everyaction.com/k/65627745/414063772/-882776279?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9BVi9BVkxDVi8xLzcwODc3IiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogIjM2YmQzNTE3LWExMTYtZWUxMS1hOWJiLTAwMjI0ODMyZWI3MyIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=7gVY6lmU7UUMR7BHyDdrtSoIRYjqrM6-DuUVNuyLMU8=&emci=24f53808-de15-ee11-a9bb-00224832eb73&emdi=36bd3517-a116-ee11-a9bb-00224832eb73&ceid=2107230) | | | Dear Peter, It was pretty hard to miss that this year’s legislative session in Oregon was tough. With ten Republican senators participating in the longest walk-out in Oregon's history it ground our state’s governing body almost to a halt. It wasn’t clear until a mere ten days until the end of session that enough Republicans would return, enabling the legislature to continue its business of serving the people of this state. To say that this anti-democratic behavior has to stop would be an understatement. Yet, despite their best efforts to shut down the state due to their opposition to gun control, abortion rights, and gender affirming care, we were collectively able to accomplish a great deal in the 2023 Oregon Legislative Session. **Our Priorities:** **1) Passed: The Climate Resilience Package** \- these bills (HB 3409 and HB 3630) were a package created by the House Speaker and Senate President’s office to make sure the state didn’t miss a beat in progressing transformative climate policies this session once (if) the Republican Senators returned to work. This package includes our Building Resilience and Natural Climate Solutions bills, all of which were major priorities for the session. In short: This comprehensive package brings together and provides $90 million in funding for more than a dozen bills related to climate action––helping Oregon compete for the billions of dollars of Federal funding on the table from the Inflation Reduction Act. **2) Toxic Free Package** \- Two of our bills in this three bills package passed once the Senate Republicans decided to come back to work:
* **Passed: Toxic Free Kids Act Modernization (HB 3043)** \- Once the Republicans returned we were able to pass this overdue bill that updates Oregon’s Toxic Free Kids Act by allowing more chemicals to be added to it to better protect our children from harmful toxins.
* **Passed:** **Toxic Free Cosmetics (SB 546)** \- This bill requiring personal care product companies publish all the ingredients of their products on their websites, and leads to the phasing out of the most toxic chemicals (like formaldehyde) also passed once the Republicans came back to work.
* **Did Not Pass:** **Toxic Free Schools (SB 426)** \- Unfortunately this bill, which would have funded the creation of a pesticide tracking system on school grounds and would have required transitioning to less or non-toxic alternatives, did not make it out of the powerful Ways and Means committee. This bill may have had a chance had time not been so limited by the Republican walk out, but we hope to make progress on this in the 2024 short session.

**3) Zero Waste Package** \- two of the bills in this four bill package made it over the finish line this year, at least one that didn’t make it would have, had the walkout not occurred and there was a little more time to amend and move the bill.
* **Passed: Styrofoam Phase Out (SB 543)** \- Passed before the walkout! This bill phases out the use of styrofoam in food to-go containers, as well as bans the use of highly carcinogenic PFAS chemicals in food packaging.
* **Passed: Legalizing Reusable Containers (SB 545)** \- Passed before the walkout! Updates Oregon law to allow for reusable containers to be used in the bulk section of the supermarket and for eating out.
* **Did Not Pass: Right to Repair (SB 542**) - would have reduced electronic waste and saved people hundreds of dollars a year by allowing them to repair their own electronics, similar to how we get our cars repaired. We ran out of time at the end of session, due to the walk out, to amend and move this bill to a vote. This will be a priority for the short session in 2024.
* **Did Not Pass: Reducing Plastic at the Source (SB 544)** \- A bill that would have required a 25% Reduction of Single Use Packaging in 10 Years. Unfortunately, this bill did not make it past the first first chamber deadline. Sometimes it takes several tries to pass transformative bills like this.

**4) Climate, Environment, and Natural Resources Budget** - It’s challenging to tell the story of the budget in a short talking point. But at the end of the day, we had a very substantial climate budget in the 2023 session. We took some hits–with cuts to the Marine Reserves Program, the only program that protects ocean habitats in the state of Oregon, and with an additional (unnecessary) $800,000 dollars going to the Wolf Compensation Fund. It’s never satisfying to see cuts to key programs, while other programs get more money they don’t need. However, in a year where we were expecting dramatic cuts, we got lucky with a much rosier budget forecast in the middle of the session that helped keep our budgets stronger than expected overall. We didn’t hold on to all the gains in the last couple sessions, but we fared well on the budget front. **5) Weakened Bill Passed: The Factory Farm Moratorium** \- After four public hearings where farmers, rural community members, and environmental advocates testified in favor of protecting Oregon’s farmers, rural communities, and our air, water, and climate from factory farming, we ended up needing to make a compromise to get the bill passed. The version of SB 85 that ultimately passed limits the amount of water that farms can use to water their livestock (something that until now has been completely unregulated). Though this version of the bill was not strong enough to remain a priority bill, it is still a significant first step to regulating factory farms, and it will help to protect the Willamette Valley from the big chicken factory farms that are eager to take over our state. **Major Threats:** While six Major Threat bills were introduced this session, we either succeeded in killing those bills, or negotiated to make them substantially better. Several major threat bills that would have weakened Oregon’s land use laws for such projects as developing ports or expanding microchip production (SB 4) were improved. We also worked hard to make sure that the majority of Oregonians and our pro-conservation values are better represented on the Fish and Wildlife Commission by significantly improving a bill to reform the Commission responsible for overseeing the Oregon Department of Fish and Wildlife (HB 3086). With so many of you speaking up, we were able to get significant improvements to bills that passed, and killed the Major Threats that were not improved–like HB 2659 which would have rolled back Climate Friendly and Equitable Communities. Incredibly, thanks to all of our efforts, **not a single major threat bill passed in the 2023 Legislative Session.** As happens every session, some hard compromises were made, some bad bills passed, and too many good bills died (like 100% Clean Energy for Data Centers and regulation of deadly diesel pollution from indirect sources). As always, we will keep up the fight in future legislative sessions to protect our public health, climate, wildlife, and our environment. Please keep an eye out for the 2023 OLCV Legislative Scorecard to get a deeper analysis of how all the environmental, climate, and environmental bills fared this legislative session. Thank you for everything you did to help us get important bills passed this session and for helping us stop the worst bills from passing. **[Please take a moment today to send a message to your lawmakers](https://click.everyaction.com/k/65627746/414063773/-882776279?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9BVi9BVkxDVi8xLzcwODc3IiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogIjM2YmQzNTE3LWExMTYtZWUxMS1hOWJiLTAwMjI0ODMyZWI3MyIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=7gVY6lmU7UUMR7BHyDdrtSoIRYjqrM6-DuUVNuyLMU8=&emci=24f53808-de15-ee11-a9bb-00224832eb73&emdi=36bd3517-a116-ee11-a9bb-00224832eb73&ceid=2107230)**[–](https://click.everyaction.com/k/65627747/414063774/-882776279?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9BVi9BVkxDVi8xLzcwODc3IiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogIjM2YmQzNTE3LWExMTYtZWUxMS1hOWJiLTAwMjI0ODMyZWI3MyIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=7gVY6lmU7UUMR7BHyDdrtSoIRYjqrM6-DuUVNuyLMU8=&emci=24f53808-de15-ee11-a9bb-00224832eb73&emdi=36bd3517-a116-ee11-a9bb-00224832eb73&ceid=2107230)**[either to thank them for being champions on the Climate Resilience Package, or to let them know you would have appreciated a yes vote from them.](https://click.everyaction.com/k/65627748/414063775/-882776279?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9BVi9BVkxDVi8xLzcwODc3IiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogIjM2YmQzNTE3LWExMTYtZWUxMS1hOWJiLTAwMjI0ODMyZWI3MyIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=7gVY6lmU7UUMR7BHyDdrtSoIRYjqrM6-DuUVNuyLMU8=&emci=24f53808-de15-ee11-a9bb-00224832eb73&emdi=36bd3517-a116-ee11-a9bb-00224832eb73&ceid=2107230)** And for a deeper dive into what happened this session, keep an eye out for our scorecard in the fall. Thank you for all that you do, Julia DeGraw
Coalition Director, OLCV | |

Several major threat bills that would have weakened Oregon’s land use laws for such projects as developing ports or expanding microchip production (SB 4) were improved. We also worked hard to make sure that the majority of Oregonians and our pro-conservation values are better represented on the Fish and Wildlife Commission by significantly improving a bill to reform the Commission responsible for overseeing the Oregon Department of Fish and Wildlife (HB 3086). With so many of you speaking up, we were able to get significant improvements to bills that passed, and killed the Major Threats that were not improved–like HB 2659 which would have rolled back Climate Friendly and Equitable Communities. Incredibly, thanks to all of our efforts, not a single major threat bill passed in the 2023 Legislative Session. As happens every session, some hard compromises were made, some bad bills passed, and too many good bills died (like 100% Clean Energy for Data Centers and regulation of deadly diesel pollution from indirect sources). As always, we will keep up the fight in future legislative sessions to protect our public health, climate, wildlife, and our environment. Please keep an eye out for the 2023 OLCV Legislative Scorecard to get a deeper analysis of how all the environmental, climate, and environmental bills fared this legislative session. Thank you for everything you did to help us get important bills passed this session and for helping us stop the worst bills from passing. ** And for a deeper dive into what happened this session, keep an eye out for our scorecard in the fall. Friend, I hope you're doing well.

We came SO close to winning last year. But one of the biggest obstacles we faced was massive outside spending from Republican PACs. By November 2022, we were outspent 6:1.
There's a lot of reasons to believe this year will be different. I'm proud to be the very first challenger endorsed by EMILYs List, and to have the support of great public servants like Senator Mark Kelly. And unlike in 2022, the Democratic Congressional Campaign Committee is already investing in flipping this district.
But we also need to show the incredible grassroots support backing my campaign.
I will stand up for each and every person in AZ-06 while in Congress. I'll fight for our reproductive rights, our environment, our Social Security & Medicare, our teachers and schools, and our water security.

Whether it's $5 or $500, this campaign is powered by people like you. We have some great momentum, but we need just a little more to hit our fundraising goal for this quarter. | Fellow American,

There is a very concerning trend occurring in our country that has me worried for Americans who hold to biblical & faith-based values. [](https://links.freedomnationtoday.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=ff5e2f70ccf7471a80ddc17d6f88682f&_e=qvsdCH07dHuVmn34w6UBlSt-m2OUaOAJ6mCDv5FPu159fX4MlRSuv9hFXU2depF2fHyr5N7AJNLLFpq54mVc2ZizcjDl3o75-_Lgejd21diwqfi41-VR0PxzuGrCEeJd0w4drG3GOXM3lVeyuTP6LZA3N7AGn8yjVhhVgHegrPMNV8BtB1Ws1cQUBRPFc2mnBde2hekX-BFcAxf-w0QdA4xHY1ChX6qHYMYx2o90pyLb-rr123RN12y4lVyVNpT2_mKoZWddN7kTjnpVkoAlO6m1wgN7MxVBiEQSApkRiER0Lj0ib8MOAkakdnWL1dYL5F2zuMNkOcRvnthGeVg_1f-9Qrb6q-g1d8CDYxlGgN_1X0d0whXlK927xC6dYqs1lDJD_7WKyJHQriS9b9YBDZ7FIODn_5XFcqxk9xYHovw%3D) After the _Respect for Marriage Act_ was passed by a bi-partisan effort and signed into law, I am fearful that legal persecution will only intensify against Americans holding to faith-based values and who wish to conduct their lives according to their faith.

[**Are you concerned that America is abandoning a basic tenet of our founding -_Religious Liberty?_**](https://links.freedomnationtoday.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=ff5e2f70ccf7471a80ddc17d6f88682f&_e=qvsdCH07dHuVmn34w6UBlSt-m2OUaOAJ6mCDv5FPu159fX4MlRSuv9hFXU2depF2fHyr5N7AJNLLFpq54mVc2ZizcjDl3o75-_Lgejd21diwqfi41-VR0PxzuGrCEeJd0w4drG3GOXM3lVeyuTP6LZA3N7AGn8yjVhhVgHegrPMNV8BtB1Ws1cQUBRPFc2mnBde2hekX-BFcAxf-w0QdA4xHY1ChX6qHYMYx2o90pyLb-rr123RN12y4lVyVNpT2_mKoZWddN7kTjnpVkoAlO7rpUtY0vWKt_BMqEgLvfiUI3_tsD8nmVsp6s4MeneZAJSam6H8nPFCwfSmBRA2efqX796sYiz2t8QN1irdqmLyha2zxDAiTJDlbbYnXVLlwAMz5S01s3NVQ9rJPR-xUArMkcALZm9vFYgzPJgcDXP0%3D)

In addition to the passing of the _Respect for Marriage Act_ , numerous examples over the past decade have concerned me: KENNEDY v. BREMERTON SCHOOL DISTRICT, MASTERPIECE CAKESHOP v. COLORADO CIVIL RIGHTS COMMISSION, and 303 CREATIVE v. ELENIS are just a few examples of legal persecution against Americans holding to faith-based values who wish to conduct their lives according to their faith.

Furthermore, an amendment to the _Respect for Marriage Act_ , brought forth by Senator Mike Lee, prohibiting the Federal Government from retaliating against schools, businesses, and organizations because of their religious beliefs about same-sex marriage failed.

**This has the potential to only intensify legal persecution against individuals, businesses, churches, and nonprofits holding to faith-based values. **

The American Cornerstone Institute is a non-profit that I founded to preserve and promote the cornerstones that laid the foundation for the greatest nation the world has ever seen: Faith, Liberty, Community, and Life.

Whether it is a football coach losing his job for praying at midfield after a game, or a baker being sued for not wanting to bake a cake that violates his religious values, **are you concerned as I am with the increase in legal persecution against Americans who wish to conduct their lives according to their faith?**

Please share your thoughts in this quick 2-minute survey concerning religious liberty in America.

**[https://offers.americancornerstone.org/religious-liberty-survey/](https://links.freedomnationtoday.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=ff5e2f70ccf7471a80ddc17d6f88682f&_e=qvsdCH07dHuVmn34w6UBlSt-m2OUaOAJ6mCDv5FPu159fX4MlRSuv9hFXU2depF2fHyr5N7AJNLLFpq54mVc2ZizcjDl3o75-_Lgejd21diwqfi41-VR0PxzuGrCEeJd0w4drG3GOXM3lVeyuTP6LZA3N7AGn8yjVhhVgHegrPMNV8BtB1Ws1cQUBRPFc2mnBde2hekX-BFcAxf-w0QdA4xHY1ChX6qHYMYx2o90pyLb-rr123RN12y4lVyVNpT2_mKoZWddN7kTjnpVkoAlOzmC6o1Am1093Kgb-OW0bG1ViUjypeLKplk7aqmWn_uuhdtE3erSH_9-4s1Tax1LTolys0hGtr76339QzBhXEfBYTzxmrRwPWU-Me2iHA2IqjmNmTHzqZp_VixQPXwQ03rVgZockA9HO-B6DIeAwSUc%3D)**

Thank you for your consideration.

Regards,

Dr. Ben Carson
Founder & Chairman American Cornerstone Institute
