Hi Peter, it's Chip, former state Democratic Party Chair and Heidi’s campaign Treasurer.
Peter, our first public Campaign Finance Reporting Deadline is tomorrow at MIDNIGHT. These finance reports are an opportunity to show that Nashville is ready for Heidi to use her years of public service experience to put our city first.
These reports are our opportunity to demonstrate that Nashvillians are tired of the state’s hostile takeover and policies that don’t represent us or our values.
Peter, investments now will help us build energy, momentum, and support as we head towards Election Day. Can we count on you to pitch in today to show your support and bolster our momentum before reports are due? [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/campbell-email?refcode=20230629_em_fr_b1_CF_acq]
PITCH IN >> [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/campbell-email?refcode=20230629_em_fr_b1_CF_acq]
Strong fundraising numbers now will also allow us to execute a strong Get Out The Vote push before the upcoming election.
The more resources we have now, the more everyone on Team Heidi can budget around phone banking, door knocking, texting, and Getting Out the Vote.
It’s really important that we help our friends and neighbors develop their voting plans and spread the word about Heidi— especially during an off-year election on a Thursday.
Peter, will you donate whatever you’re able today to help us hit the ground running with a good report and run our voter outreach program through Election Day? >> [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/campbell-email?refcode=20230629_em_fr_b1_CF_acq]
DONATE NOW [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/campbell-email?refcode=20230629_em_fr_b1_CF_acq]
With gratitude,
Chip Forrester, Treasurer
Campbell for Mayor
Heidi Campbell is a Nashville native, Mom, former music industry executive and the first female mayor of the city of Oak Hill.
https://secure.actblue.com/donate/campbell-email?refcode=20230629_em_fr_b1_CF_acq [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/campbell-email?refcode=20230629_em_fr_b1_CF_acq]
As mayor, Heidi established a track record for fiscal discipline, balancing the budget every year of her Mayorship, eliminating my own salary, and returning $2M to my city’s reserves.
Heidi was elected in November of 2020 to represent District 20 in the Tennessee State Senate. Since then, she’s been an outspoken advocate for science, the LGBTQ community, public education, local control, women's and kids' issues, Medicaid expansion, and the environment.
Heidi sponsored or co-sponsored over 100 pieces of legislation in her first year in the senate, including legislation to allow cities to offer paid family leave, increase funding for school counselors and reading interventionists, and make it easier to cast a vote.
Heidi is focused on sustainable infrastructure, economic development and job creation, fully funding our public schools and supporting educators, expanding access to affordable healthcare, investing in suicide prevention, making certain that vulnerable children in state custody are not falling through the cracks, and ensuring that every Tennessean - regardless of ethnicity, gender, sexual orientation, age or ability - can achieve the American Dream.
Election Day is Thursday, August 3, 2023.

June 30 marks our first FEC deadline since we launched this campaign.
What’s that mean? After that, we’ll have to publicly report how much money this grassroots team has raised -- our first chance to really size things up and see how ready we are to build a campaign that can compete for the long haul.
This is a big fundraising deadline! So I'm asking you personally:
Will you chip in $24 split between my friend Sara Jacobs' campaign and my reelection campaign today?

If you’ve saved your payment information with ActBlue Express, your donation will go through immediately:

We’ve helped create a record 13 million new jobs -- with more jobs created in two years than any president has ever created in four. We passed a once-in-a-generation infrastructure law, building bridges to connect our nation. We’re lowering costs for working families, combating climate change, and making big corporations pay their fair share. But our work to build a better America is far from over.
Sara Jacobs and I are counting on your support so we can elect Democrats in every corner of the country.
Split a $24 donation between Sara's campaign and my reelection campaign ahead of Friday’s end-of-quarter deadline. [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/sjj-em-potus]

body:

48 DONORS TO GOAL [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/about-bob]
,
If you read the news, [https://www.bridgemi.com/business-watch/western-upper-peninsula-towns-empty-out-look-wisconsin-lessons] you know our district is witnessing a mass exodus. In one county, for every birth, there are five deaths. Where there once were bustling and thriving downtowns, now you could "roll a bowling ball down main street."
High school graduates are pursuing education opportunities out of state and not returning because of a lack of job prospects. It's happening all across our rural communities because of a lack of opportunity, and partly because of poor leadership from do-nothing, careless Congresspeople like Rep. Jack Bergman.
There's good news - With your help, I will replace him, and turn this ship around! Rural communities can thrive; we just need political will, better policy, and a leader who gives a damn.
3 INJUSTICES
I SAW JUST THIS WEEK
Here are just three gross injustices I see in our district every day that we need to address immediately:
1. Cost of Childcare
I heard from a constituent who said to me, "Childcare is too expensive, so I can't really afford to go to work."
Think about that. No parent should have to choose between pursuing their dreams and providing quality care for their little ones. Because of the astronomical costs of childcare, it can be more expensive to work than it is to stay home.
It should never cost too much to work. MI01 needs family sustaining jobs, livable wages, affordable housing, education, healthcare and childcare — Now!
_____
2. A Broken Healthcare System
Another GoFundMe page was published to cover an emergency care visit at our local hospital.
No American should have to start a GoFundMe page to pay for healthcare during a medical crisis. It's an absolute sin that over 50% of cancer patients go bankrupt within a year of their diagnosis.
Bless the ones who do, but no one should have to collect donations to save their lives. We need a publicly financed, non-profit national health insurance program that fully covers medical care costs for all Americans.
_____
3. Inequitable Taxes
I researched corporate tax loopholes.
It's appalling that billionaires can pay lower tax rates than the working-class in MI01. The ultra-rich must contribute their fair share to invest in education, healthcare, and infrastructure. We can build an economy that benefits everyone and leaves no one behind; all it requires is political will. I have it.
_____
, Tomorrow, we hit our FEC quarterly fundraising deadline and hope to get 100 more donors before we close up the books for Q2. I want to get to DC to solve these problems, and so much more. [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/about-bob]
If you agree we need someone in Congress willing to solve problems, not create them, can you pitch in $10, $50, or more, and/or forward this e-mail to a friend?
Thank you for your consideration,
-Dr. Bob

This is the very first end-of-quarter fundraising deadline since Joe and Kamala announced their reelection campaign, which means it’s crucial that they reach their goal and demonstrate the strength of the grassroots team behind them.
I’ve seen that strength firsthand. Thanks to Democratic majorities that you built and your mobilization efforts across the country, Democrats have been delivering For the People: we’re lowering prescription drug costs while making unprecedented investments in our nation’s infrastructure and clean energy. And, under the leadership of Joe, Kamala, and congressional Democrats, we’ve reached historically low unemployment.
Now, it’s up to us to protect the progress we’ve made and keep building on it: we must defend our freedoms and our democracy from the extreme MAGA movement focused on attacking our fundamental rights.
**I have no doubt we can win the fights ahead of us. But to do so, we must take back the House, defend the Senate, and ensure Joe and Kamala return to the White House.**

| Dear Neighbor,
Last week, Republicans, Democrats, and Independents alike sent a resounding message and a demand for citizen-first development, lower property taxes, and a return to a safe and secure Prince William County.
Though outnumbered, I'm proud to have led the fight for each of these issues over the last three and a half years and am asking for your help to continue that fight today.
Friday night at midnight is this fundraising quarter's deadline.
I know I just messaged you a few weeks ago prior to the primary deadline. If you were able to support our cause at any amount \- thank you. Your support is going a long way to help restore the quality of life we all moved here to Prince William County to raise our families and enjoy.
If you haven't yet been able to invest into our campaign I would be exceedingly grateful for your consideration to continue the vital work we started four years ago. Regardless of party, folks are fed up with the direction our county has been going in and are ready for change.
With your help, we'll restore a majority committed to putting our law-abiding residents over special interests in matters of development, taxes, and crime.
[Please click here to make a contribution of any amount today](https://r20.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001Aj8EvClkt7y_cPtQktxalTRdDjD4Mik-kP_f-3xutJuiqrOCKnr3am3ZZMKnRnJr43JD_8JUk5V10XYhSlRMg73Pgl2jBFl_0WloM7qoI2R6I728JbZ1cgEHu4B8X0EWzRiOyr567TIitz41pGnB7B7qZaPRonPjZ_CUE4tC64IWydZreu6gliXGEAs6JPG6&c=oYQy9eWe88D5AYfnYiNzLYYF6oudrr5S150mDFogNa09LAwQ_MhfCw==&ch=NBcLSW_1omxVlNzOZFn49LCIwz9VeJqnl-CzAldvLewbHIMqFV6gOA==).

But make no mistake, the money train and powerful special interests that spent hundreds of thousands backing Chair Wheeler and the majority aren't going away.

subject: Pride doesn’t end in June
body:

**Friends -** As the month of June ends, it’s important to say that LGBTQ+ visibility is an everyday part of a more equal system and society. The flags may be put away, and stores will roll their rainbow merchandise to the clearance section, but our lives and experiences continue to be a part of our story as a nation. This is who we are. We live with pride every day. If we truly believe in a more equal and just system, then we must work beyond the celebration and fanfare of Pride as a scheduled time in the year. We must work to push back against anti-LGBTQ+ laws and the radical right’s mission that is solely based on bigotry. We must continue to be allies every day of the year. Friends, with more LGBTQ+ visibility and more voices heard on a national stage, we can ensure that these laws and the bigotry that creates them are shunned out of public light. clean_body: Friends - As the month of June ends, it’s important to say that LGBTQ+ visibility is an everyday part of a m | | | Friends - As the month of June ends, it’s important to say that LGBTQ+ visibility is an everyday part of a more equal system and society. The flags may be put away, and stores will roll their rainbow merchandise to the clearance section, but our lives and experiences continue to be a part of our story as a nation. This is who we are. We live with pride every day. If we truly believe in a more equal and just system, then we must work beyond the celebration and fanfare of Pride as a scheduled time in the year. We must work to push back against anti-LGBTQ+ laws and the radical right’s mission that is solely based on bigotry. We must continue to be allies every day of the year. Friends, with more LGBTQ+ visibility and more voices heard on a national stage, we can ensure that these laws and the bigotry that creates them are shunned out of public light. . | | = | | = | | = | | = | | Thank you. ▪ Mia | ▪ | Mia ---|--- "Facebook" "Instagram" "Twitter" "YouTube" ©2023 Mia Mason for Congress | 1597 bowis dr, po box 124, Point of Rocks, MD, 21777 | == "Web Version" == "Preferences" == "Forward" "Unsubscribe" |

Dear friend, one of the biggest moments of our year is coming up fast, and I knew I had to reach out to you early with a crucial update. Our planet is at a critical tipping point. This means our fight to protect vital ecosystems and the creatures that depend on them is more urgent than ever.
Friends of the Earth won’t take excuses from bad actors and the mega-polluting industries pushing our planet to the brink. We see clearly that **corporate pollution is a choice.** **Together, we WILL hold companies accountable for that choice. **
**Right now, innocent animals are facing extreme risk of extinction from human-driven habitat loss and the worsening climate crisis. Mega-manufacturing plants are covering our planet in single-use plastics just to rack up more profits. The amount of their plastics in our oceans could exceed the number of fish by 2050 unless we act. Meanwhile, mining, logging and drilling companies are aggressively attacking the Endangered Species Act – our strongest protection for vulnerable creatures and the vital habitats they call home. **
We know the consequences of their rampant greed will be devastating pollution and the destruction of lands and waterways essential to wildlife survival and to human health. **But it doesn’t have to be this way, and we don’t have to stand aside while our only Earth collapses under this terrible burden. **
**That’s why this opportunity is so important: A generous group of donors is matching every gift we receive up to our $150,000 End of Fiscal Year goal, but only until midnight FRIDAY. Because you've been such a committed supporter, we created a custom match link you can use to be the first to DOUBLE your impact at this crucial moment in our fight for the planet and its inhabitants. So please hurry and make your gift for our planet now! Here’s your personal link:**
| | [[EARLY MATCH ACCESS FOR dpwillis67@gmail.com]](https://us.engagingnetworks.app/page/email/click/10012/1852957?email=RepJ2ZGQKX6xm5Aey7FwClESkN1MQhKC&campid=UI6tX83ZqbKZkArzVWMSmA==)
---
This goal means so much to our organization and the planet. We chose you to be part of this select group for early match access because we know you understand how high the stakes are for our Earth and everything that lives on it. **When you make your early-bird membership donation now, you'll be ensuring that Friends of the Earth can continue to mobilize activists on the ground, keep pressure on our lawmakers to do the right thing and stop the corporation-driven pollution crisis from putting the future of our planet at risk. **
The situation is dire, but getting complacent or giving in to despair is simply not an option. That’s why we must seize this opportunity for our planet right now, friend. **Matches like this don’t come often, and the stakes for our only Earth have never been higher. **So we’re counting on committed environmentalists like you to set the pace for the rest of our community.
**We've got to make this goal really count. So please, your personalized match access link is right here – donate now to have every dollar doubled toward our crucial End of Fiscal Year goal:**
| | [[EARLY MATCH ACCESS FOR dpwillis67@gmail.com]](https://us.engagingnetworks.app/page/email/click/10012/1852957?email=RepJ2ZGQKX6xm5Aey7FwClESkN1MQhKC&campid=UI6tX83ZqbKZkArzVWMSmA==)

**I wanted you to be the first to know...I’m running for Congress!**_[**If you’re already all-in, will you split a donation between my campaign and HER Time today?**](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/65658716/414121379/1224142042?refcode=AU_HTP_FR_TAN_GEN_AC_20230629_PM1_V1_S1&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNDYvMS8xMDI1NDMiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiMGU1MGQ4MmEtYzgxNi1lZTExLWE5YmItMDAyMjQ4MzJlYjczIiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=enjcBMULzYJcj1ETMfKSTL-08QxiGjXr5OXtUYc9ALs=)_ In 2020, I became the first openly trans person elected to serve as a State Senator anywhere in the country. It really felt like America was blazing a path to the future. But since then, the far-right has tried to use the LGBTQ community as a scapegoat for their own policy failures. As they’ve increased their attacks on families and kids, it has become even clearer: **for our democracy to work, it needs to include _all_ of us. We need to have a trans representative at the table in Congress.** I’ve seen firsthand in the Delaware State Senate that **our presence in the halls of power changes the culture of the most important institutions in our country** — and when it does, _we can make government work better for families and workers._ **In Delaware, I’ve worked with Democrats _and_ Republicans to pass a historic paid family and medical leave law, pass nondiscrimination protections, combat disinformation online, and take on the gun lobby (and win). ** On occasion I have had to put my foot down; like when I blocked anti-trans legislation from moving through my committee. But I was able to do that because**_I knew my home state, and supporters like you across the country, would have my back. _** _[**I’m ready to make history and be a bold changemaker in Congress, but I need your help to win in 2024. body:
We have a mandate to ensure our rights are not stripped away by bought-and-paid-for judges trying to implement a fascist agenda. | |
---
Peter, BREAKING: The Supreme Court decision on affirmative action today is an affirmation of white supremacy, not justice or equality. In her dissent, **Justice Ketanji Brown Jackson put it perfectly:**
> _“With let-them-eat-cake obliviousness, today, the majority pulls the ripcord and announces ‘colorblindness for all’ by legal fiat. But deeming race irrelevant in law does not make it so in life.”_
**Make no mistake about it.** This Court’s decision will disproportionately harm our communities. Universities historically denied Black, brown, and Indigenous people from accessing an education. Affirmative action helped level the racist and uneven playing field. Its protections were designed to increase equity and inclusion. Now, with those protections abolished, systemic racism will again be magnified. The Supreme Court is a cesspool of corruption, devastating our communities. Because of the decisions made by an unethical and illegitimate SCOTUS majority, Americans are unable to access abortion care, have weaker labor protections, are more vulnerable to voter suppression, and are subjected to a racist legal system. [**We have a mandate to ensure our rights are not stripped away by bought-and-paid-for judges trying to implement a fascist agenda. I’m proud to lead on the _Judiciary Act_ , which would expand the Supreme Court and help us reclaim our democracy once and for all. Will you join me in pushing back and building support for the _Judiciary Act_ by adding your voice now?**](https://click.actionnetwork.org/ss/c/P8Elou2Rvc0qoMPEUZrMXcOpy_XqN4R2ZGjoK-5zZnmlf9yb9ilux69QpyOCfiDuyCMdXjk8e1QCbmfKhkEn1f1MxwxEQDstb8URsx0tZWOsDCGEKva3Y5PbK8rP3_hYDB2mGu1VdDk5vu-6AWnO0Mi-UEmy9Gty9VSgYJRB5XAOfbWEdLnoT4I1VBuFZNz4pf6JDXMgQNtUTDehKFGqPppd5zk1cv7VAXHnDDYmaHXhf7wU1ZhSxKkWM5YB_fJJq_RzCzlOkSKhs9zZM0rGjDxd_TJ401S4kz9anbD-Ve612wzDXm81lT8gnpuYO1aIuJFDJTx-Br0pBpMYZZFBuhy6OHVcZtrpNxKMaMpXiiIa3PG93oM-UO9yvsfsgYigMb2DvrUPsnWKjp5t_Ha80w/3xg/FX83UIX8RU63_myJ1J4x7Q/h0/PCmTcdeD3A2LroWJpRnZbPCgAIGnRYKyBP5S-7im6nk) **[EXPAND THE COURT](https://click.actionnetwork.org/ss/c/P8Elou2Rvc0qoMPEUZrMXcOpy_XqN4R2ZGjoK-5zZnmlf9yb9ilux69QpyOCfiDuyCMdXjk8e1QCbmfKhkEn1f1MxwxEQDstb8URsx0tZWOxd7EjXnXR4I84BOkbX11jYA3kwso6x7HZ43kOGAeN6u_-AIr20g4l04Q1nNxUWVE2iZ6bCMSgtsqF7OdyGRtedGR48MHq5l4LcBrtfJIuDVuGGaTgJ1EX6yyjMLzly0rj2bSIgFxdMF1NFckwja_YbB8QklrWwT8YQ9_mgEZJyjAGt5TcdwqacybNbHkp4LilIL0Ed_6zU36WsPIAqbExaE3Iu4zIxZ1ObOhsH_BZrEqqvNgYG6qDdwzJSwjCJRY-IrQzs5IAJlXkhTItMyjugigUc8XJQsx9Xkep5bOYyw/3xg/FX83UIX8RU63_myJ1J4x7Q/h1/Jyv8VWPOFNw03NaucrsM-NGfU6z7eB9Cs7uBxzCcXuE)** **Affirmative action seeks to level a racist and uneven playing field. Ending it is devastating to communities.** In its dedication to moving backwards, the Supreme Court has once again rolled back protections for people in marginalized communities across this country. Rulings like this are another example of why the American people’s confidence in the nation’s highest court has fallen to a record low. With equally horrific decisions expected tomorrow on student debt and LGBTQ+ rights, we shouldn’t have to hold our collective breath for the Supreme Court to make decisions about our rights when the correct rulings are clear. Congressional Republicans have employed their far-right judicial playbook by disregarding norms and precedent in the confirmation process to steal the Court. **It’s up to us to take back the Court for the American people.** Congress can determine the size of the Supreme Court; it has already added and removed seats on the Court seven times throughout its history. [**Congress must take action now to expand the Court once again, but to make it happen, I need your help to build support. Fellow Patriot, I’m sure you’ve seen today’s headlines- the U.S. Supreme Court issued a landmark victory for equality in America by striking down racial preferences (aka “affirmative action”).The Court ruled that the race-based undergraduate admissions practices of Harvard and the University of North Carolina violate the Constitution’s Equal Protection guarantee.This is great news, but this is exactly when the real fight begins!This ruling means we must now strike hard legally in our courts, while the iron is hot, and win major victories. But we can’t do this alone, we need your help.Universities have already begun working to keep their current policies in place, or do everything they can to find a way around this morning’s ruling, so they can continue to discriminate based on race. In fact, shortly after the ruling was released, Harvard already put out statements to this effect!AFL has launched a national hotline (1-877-AFL-5454) so that Americans who are victimized by illegal “equity” policies can contact our legal team. Additionally, we have a digital hotline ([_AFLegal.org/hotline_](http://xykkk.mjt.lu/lnk/AV8AABw3PJwAAAAOV94AAEcY2LAAAAABL9MAAGV0ABg1MgBkngJJ-tR5sHE1Qn-Tdbrz8iUWswAXqZI/2/eJevC64gpJ_FHJVaVQwlpA/aHR0cHM6Ly9hZmxlZ2FsLm9yZy9ob3RsaW5lLw)) and our email tip line (equality@aflegal.org).Here is the ad that we are running right now on Twitter: ([_https://twitter.com/America1stLegal/status/1674447433634381824?s=20_](http://xykkk.mjt.lu/lnk/AV8AABw3PJwAAAAOV94AAEcY2LAAAAABL9MAAGV0ABg1MgBkngJJ-tR5sHE1Qn-Tdbrz8iUWswAXqZI/3/WQjZ1iyGwj94dqs-LAkkEw/aHR0cHM6Ly90d2l0dGVyLmNvbS9BbWVyaWNhMXN0TGVnYWwvc3RhdHVzLzE2NzQ0NDc0MzM2MzQzODE4MjQ_cz0yMA))America First Legal stands alone as a legal nonprofit in its determination to thwart the lawless equity regime that has pervaded every aspect of American life and society.At this crucial moment in time, we stand at a legal crossroads.You have the power to help us restore equal justice and equal treatment under the law-and to help deserving Americans in search of justice. Already, AFL has successfully pushed back against parts of the equity agenda. We defeated multiple discriminatory federal government programs, filed 19 federal civil rights complaints against woke corporations, government agencies, and universities for their illegal and racist hiring and employment practices, and filed multiple class-action lawsuits against universities and private companies implementing discriminatory policies.We need your help now as we work to raise $500,000 to run a series of ads throughout the nation to educate more Americans about their legal rights and to inform them of AFL’s digital hotline and services.With your help, together we can immediately strike hard in the courts and win major victories on behalf of all Americans!_Please consider making a donation to help us now!_ Mary Thomas

Hi Peter,
In a moment, I’m going to ask you to make your first donation to my campaign. But before I do, I want to explain _why_ your contribution is so important.
The truth is, running for Congress is not a glamorous affair. Many of us have this patriotic impression that all it takes to run for office is a passion for public service and a good handshake – but that’s not the world we live in.
The truth is, campaigning takes money – _a lot_ of it.
It costs money to afford to travel all around the 1st District, visiting voters and pounding the pavement (or the dirt roads!).
It takes money to hire campaign staff and set up field offices – especially in a district as large as ours.
And it’s going to take a lot of money to buy advertisements on TV and the internet in order to spread our message and unseat Rep. Jack Bergman.
**I’m running for Congress because Northern Michigan and the Upper Peninsula deserve a representative who will work for us – but I can’t do it alone.**

body:
Hi, friend, it's Colin, and I had to reach out one more time before our end-of-quarter deadline – the first major public fundraising goal of this campaign – because unfortunately, we're still short of our $750,000 goal.
Our ability to defeat Ted Cruz depends on reaching critical fundraising goals like this one. 2018 was the most expensive Senate race Texas has ever seen, and Democrats came within 2.6% of defeating Ted Cruz.
**And listen: A new poll says 14% of Texas voters are undecided – so we need to be able to reach each and every voter to win this race.**
**Please I'm personally asking: Will you chip in $3 or whatever you can spare, and split a donation between my campaign and The Long Run before my first public fundraising deadline tomorrow? Every dollar helps in our fight to defeat Ted Cruz.**
**Here's the best link to make your gift:[https://act.mandelabarnes.com/go/Allred-deadline**](https://act.mandelabarnes.com/go/1212?c0=longrunpac-em-allred-split.fIsyEE&refcode=em230629-2-tt&t=1&akid=4601%2E196590%2EtiK_nj)

disclaimer_text: Paid For By Gallego for Arizona
body:
We had to make a pretty difficult decision yesterday, and we thought you should know about it.
#

Hey there, Peter, it's Ruben Gallego's campaign again.
We had to make a pretty difficult decision earlier today, and we thought you should know about it.
We're at the point of the race where we expect Kari Lake to jump in any day. And when we look back at the last Senate race in Arizona, this is also around the time Republicans started running outside expenditure ads to weaken Mark Kelly even though they didn't have a nominee yet.
We have to be ready for that, and, without saying too much, there are a number of investments we have to make in order to be prepared. Because getting caught off guard and letting Republicans effectively define Ruben would be trouble.
The money wasn't in the budget, but Ruben gave the green light, even though we are short of our FEC deadline goals as well. A deadline that ends tomorrow.
Ruben was banking on the fact that if we told you this, and if we asked, you would help fill the gap. And we're really hoping you can. For Ruben. And for everyone who knows we must replace Kyrsten Sinema and beat Kari Lake.
[**Can you please make a $3 contribution to Ruben Gallego's campaign for Senate today? Every donation will help fill the budget gap ahead of tomorrow's critical FEC fundraising deadline.**](https://act.gallegoforarizona.com/go/1000?c0=ruben-em-june23.4TsbMb&refcode=em230629-3-f&t=1&akid=772%2E734936%2EKk7r64)
Like we said, this was not an easy decision. But if there’s one thing that sets our campaign apart from all the others in this race, it’s the fact that we are funded by a large number of people contributing what they can.
Thanks for chipping in today if you can afford it.
All our best,
Ruben Gallego for Senate in Arizona

Friend, when we fight for workers, we fight for all people.

I'm one of the most vulnerable senators in the country, and I'm facing my toughest election yet. **The only way I can protect this seat – and keep fighting for the Dignity of Work – is if folks like you are in my corner.[So please, will you chip in $3 or more before the critical June FEC deadline?](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/65662249/414133805/691330013?&amounts=100,50,25,10,3&refcode=jtk291-fr-nd-b&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTMvMS84NzY0NSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI1MWZmYWYwZS1kMjE2LWVlMTEtYTliYi0wMDIyNDgzMmViNzMiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=VxVDb47ZI9geDrkFLZz8YekreAbB9FLwR6Ql590_17U=)**

I'm running for reelection to tackle these critical issues and make sure that our country not just recognizes – but _celebrates –_ the Dignity of Work.
**But here's why I'm worried: **Experts at _FiveThirtyEight_ say that this race could decide Senate control, and Mitch McConnell has personally named me a top target for defeat. He knows, as well as we do, that his path to taking back the majority runs straight through Ohio.

| A native Floridian with blue-collar roots, Ron was raised in Dunedin by his mother, a nurse, and father, who installed cable boxes. He attended Dunedin High School and worked his way through Yale University, where he was the captain of the varsity baseball team. He also graduated with honors from Harvard Law School, where he earned a commission in the U.S. Navy as a JAG officer.

During his active-duty service, Ron deployed to Iraq in support of the SEAL mission in Fallujah, Ramadi and the rest of Al Anbar province. His military decorations include the Bronze Star Medal for Meritorious Service and the Iraq Campaign Medal.
---
Ron also served as a prosecutor in Florida, where he put child predators behind bars. He was elected to Congress in 2012 on a platform of government accountability, advocating for term limits and a balanced budget amendment.

In Congress, DeSantis spearheaded the fight to expose the weaponization of the IRS against conservatives. He also fought to hold accountable the rogue federal agencies involved in manufacturing the "Russia collusion" conspiracy theory. As a veteran, DeSantis was a champion for those who have served our country, pushing for reforms to the VA to better serve veterans and expand support for mental health.

In 2018, Ron DeSantis was elected the 46th Governor of Florida. As governor, he has fought for what's right and taken the arrows for the people he represents. During the darkest days of 2020, when the corrupt establishment, bureaucracy, and corporate media united to force lockdowns and mandates on Americans, DeSantis stood up for freedom - even when it wasn't popular.

Grounded in his unshakeable belief in America's founding principles, Governor DeSantis has enacted a bold agenda to transform Florida into a blueprint for the Nation's revival. Governor DeSantis has delivered win after win on conservative priorities:
* Saving livelihoods from job-killing lockdowns and vaccine mandates,

* Protecting citizens from the harmful impacts of Biden's border crisis by enacting E-Verify and other bold policies against illegal immigration, such as banning sanctuary cities,

* Defending parental rights and eliminating CRT,

* Defunding DEI bureaucracy in higher ed and holding tenured professors accountable,

* Waging war on woke power-grabs like ESG and central bank digital currency,

* Enacting the strongest medical freedom laws in the nation,

* Turning Florida into a model for election integrity,

* Protecting the unborn,

* Standing up for the 2nd Amendment by making Florida a constitutional carry state,

* Expanding education freedom,

* Prohibiting land purchases by the CCP and related individuals and entities,

* Lowering prescription drug costs,

* Holding woke corporations and school unions accountable,

* Creating a universal school choice program,

* Delivering record-breaking tax relief,

* Helping families achieve the American dream of homeownership,

* Supporting law enforcement and our veterans,

* Enacting tougher penalties for drug dealers and sex offenders,

* Appointing seven conservative justices to the Florida Supreme Court,

* ...and so much more.

After leading Florida with common sense and conviction throughout his first term, DeSantis delivered a record-setting victory of nearly 20 points in 2022. He earned his second term by the largest raw vote margin in state history, winning by more than 1.5 million votes.

But history didn't stop there:

Governor DeSantis flipped Miami-Dade County red, winning the majority-Hispanic urban county by double digits. Conventional wisdom assumed this was impossible for a Republican - as recently as 2016, Hillary Clinton won Miami-Dade County by nearly 30 points.

Governor DeSantis flipped several other blue counties red, including Palm Beach County. He won 62 out of 67 counties overall.

Compared to his first statewide election in 2018, Governor DeSantis was up +19% with Independents, up +30% with Hispanics, and up +9% with women.

Governor DeSantis delivered a record-setting victory with battle-tested leadership, a bold policy agenda, and never backing down to corporate media or special interests. As he said at his inauguration: "When the world lost its mind - when common sense suddenly became an uncommon virtue - Florida was a refuge of sanity, a citadel of freedom for our fellow Americans and even for people around the world. In captaining the ship of state, we choose to navigate the boisterous sea of liberty rather than cower in the calm docks of despotism."

Governor DeSantis has ensured that Florida is a free and safe place to raise a family. Thanks to the governor's leadership, Floridians enjoy a low tax burden, quality education opportunities, and a bulwark in place against the Biden Administration's overreach and various elite power grabs that seek to force people to adopt a particular ideology. Thanks to the governor's vision, this year's legislative session delivered the most ambitious conservative policy victories in Florida's history.

This year, Governor DeSantis signed:
* Record tax relief

* ESG prohibitions

* Measures counteracting the influence of the CCP

* The strongest medical freedom protections in the nation.

* Reforms reducing the costs of medications by delivering transparency

* Bold higher education reforms; defunding DEI

* Improvements to our state's infrastructure

* Tough-on-crime, law and order measures, including the death penalty for child rapists

* The strongest measures protecting Florida from Biden's border crisis

* Reforms for paycheck protection , holding accountable wayward school unions

* Prohibitions on centralized digital currencies in Florida

No leader has accomplished more for his state than Governor DeSantis. He is now sharing his bold vision with the country, leading a movement to deliver the Great American Comeback.

Ron is married to Casey DeSantis, an Emmy Award- winning television anchor. Together, they're the proud parents of their daughters, Madison and Mamie, and their son, Mason.

Governor DeSantis has delivered win after win on conservative priorities: Saving livelihoods from job-killing lockdowns and vaccine mandates, Protecting citizens from the harmful impacts of Biden's border crisis by enacting E-Verify and other bold policies against illegal immigration, such as banning sanctuary cities, Defending parental rights and eliminating CRT, Defunding DEI bureaucracy in higher ed and holding tenured professors accountable, Waging war on woke power-grabs like ESG and central bank digital currency, Enacting the strongest medical freedom laws in the nation, Turning Florida into a model for election integrity, Protecting the unborn, Standing up for the 2nd Amendment by making Florida a constitutional carry state, Expanding education freedom, Prohibiting land purchases by the CCP and related individuals and entities, Lowering prescription drug costs, Holding woke corporations and school unions accountable, Creating a universal school choice program, Delivering record-breaking tax relief, Helping families achieve the American dream of homeownership, Supporting law enforcement and our veterans, Enacting tougher penalties for drug dealers and sex offenders, Appointing seven conservative justices to the Florida Supreme Court, ...and so much more. After leading Florida with common sense and conviction throughout his first term, DeSantis delivered a record-setting victory of nearly 20 points in 2022. He earned his second term by the largest raw vote margin in state history, winning by more than 1.5 million votes. But history didn't stop there: Governor DeSantis flipped Miami-Dade County red, winning the majority-Hispanic urban county by double digits. Conventional wisdom assumed this was impossible for a Republican - as recently as 2016, Hillary Clinton won Miami-Dade County by nearly 30 points. Governor DeSantis flipped several other blue counties red, including Palm Beach County. He won 62 out of 67 counties overall. Compared to his first statewide election in 2018, Governor DeSantis was up +19% with Independents, up +30% with Hispanics, and up +9% with women. Governor DeSantis delivered a record-setting victory with battle-tested leadership, a bold policy agenda, and never backing down to corporate media or special interests. As he said at his inauguration: "When the world lost its mind - when common sense suddenly became an uncommon virtue - Florida was a refuge of sanity, a citadel of freedom for our fellow Americans and even for people around the world. In captaining the ship of state, we choose to navigate the boisterous sea of liberty rather than cower in the calm docks of despotism." Governor DeSantis has ensured that Florida is a free and safe place to raise a family. Thanks to the governor's leadership, Floridians enjoy a low tax burden, quality education opportunities, and a bulwark in place against the Biden Administration's overreach and various elite power grabs that seek to force people to adopt a particular ideology. Thanks to the governor's vision, this year's legislative session delivered the most ambitious conservative policy victories in Florida's history. This year, Governor DeSantis signed: Record tax relief ESG prohibitions Measures counteracting the influence of the CCP The strongest medical freedom protections in the nation. body:
# [](https://go.bobcasey.com/go/181?t=1&akid=223%2E552475%2E-gV69V)
Hello Peter,
I’m writing to ask if you will make your first donation to our campaign to help us reach our $75,000 goal before tomorrow night’s deadline. I hope you will give me a minute to explain why this request is important — **[but if you are ready to do your part right now, you can donate at this link knowing how grateful I am for your support.](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/casey-em-20230629-4?refcode=em20230629-4&refcode2=223_552475_-gV69V&akid=223%2E552475%2E-gV69V)**
The truth is, defending this Senate seat isn’t only about ensuring we can keep fighting for Pennsylvania families in Washington, as important as that is.
This is also the race that could decide if Democrats hold our Senate majority. We know that, and Mitch McConnell knows it, too.
It is hard to understate the stakes, Peter: Social Security, Medicare, and Medicaid, women’s rights, LGBTQIA+ equality, the right to vote, and more are on the line if Republicans flip the Senate next year.
We need to be able to fight back against the millions that McConnell and the GOP are going to spend here, which will hinge on our ability to meet our goals ahead of major fundraising deadlines like the one we’re facing tomorrow night.
**[Can I count on you to contribute $5 or more to our re-election campaign today, Peter? I need your help to reach our end-of-quarter goal.](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/casey-em-20230629-4?refcode=em20230629-4&refcode2=223_552475_-gV69V&akid=223%2E552475%2E-gV69V)**
**[Donate Now ››](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/casey-em-20230629-4?refcode=em20230629-4&refcode2=223_552475_-gV69V&akid=223%2E552475%2E-gV69V)**
Our deadline is less than 48 hours away and we’re close to reaching our goal, so I’m hoping your donation will put us over the top.
Thank you for your support,
Bob Casey
